Name: Corelia Bio
Description:
Corelia Bio is building a human-relevant translational platform for cardio-renal drug discovery.

Complex chronic diseases such as CKD and HFpEF involve interactions between cardiac, renal, vascular, inflammatory and metabolic biology that are not adequately represented by many conventional preclinical models. This limits confidence in target selection, biomarker strategy and therapeutic progression.

Corelia Bio is developing HETSTM — the Human Engineered Tissue System to address this translational gap. The platform combines engineered cardiac and renal disease models with functional readouts, biomarker analysis and multi-omics to generate decision-enabling evidence for:

- therapeutic target validation
- compound and mechanism-of-action profiling
- translational biomarker development
- early R&D program de-risking

Our goal is to become a specialized translational partner for pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies developing therapies for CKD, HFpEF, fibrosis and related cardio-metabolic complications.

Corelia Bio is currently progressing toward its first platform proof of concept, external validation studies and strategic development partnerships.

Name: ZAKlab GmbH
Description:
Horses and dogs - just like us humans - can only perform at their best if they are healthy and fit. Unclear lameness, exhaustion or even reluctance to eat can be signs of a treatable but difficult to diagnose disease. Classical diagnostics based on antibodies in the blood can often only provide an incomplete or even false picture of such a disease in the case of intracellular pathogens.

T-cells, another fundamental component of the immune defense, can reveal a complete immune status, especially in the case of T-cell controlled pathogens. In the human field, this type of diagnosis has become the gold standard for certain diseases in recent years. In addition to Borrelia, other pathogens of tick-borne diseases such as Rickettsia, Ehrlichia or Babesia can also be diagnosed, as well as life-threatening diseases such as tuberculosis. Furthermore, intracellular pathogens such as Mycoplasma and Bartonella or fungi (Aspergillus) can be detected with the EliSpot. Immune reactions against Yersinia, a known cause of chronic joint inflammation, can also be detected in the EliSpot.

•	Lebensmittel: Verschiedene Anwendungen in der gesamten Lebensmittelverarbeitungskette vom Erzeuger bis zum Verbraucher.
o	In der Umfeldhygiene der Lebensmittelverarbeitung
o	Anfang der Produktionskette
o	Ende der Produktionskette

Name: PathoBlock
Description:
Pseudomonas aeruginosa is one of the top three candidates on the WHO list of multidrug-resistant bacteria, which cause a serious healthcare challenge. So far, there are no realistic treatment options for antibiotic-resistant Pseudomonas bacteria.

Instead of developing more and more antibiotics, to which resistance can be acquired, we developed a novel treatment mechanism that prevents infections early on. It thereby also prevents the development of resistance combined with less side effects, which has the potential to sustainably fight bacteria.

Unlike traditional antibiotics, our approach blocks the pathogenicity of bacteria without directly killing them. This pathoblocking prevents bacteria from harming their host. Disarmed and unable to infect human cells, the bacteria are removed from the body.

Dr. Holger Müller, BlueSens gas sensor GmbH, Herten
Prof. Dr. Peter Neubauer, TU Berlin
Dr. Jens Traenkle, Bayer AG, Wuppertal

- the provision of innovative sensor systems and established sensors suitable for industrial use with a view to non-invasiveness, real-time consideration, modularity and, above all, simplicity,

Zentari is designed to help translate complex requirements into structured options and actionable outputs. The aim is stronger decisions, cleaner handoffs, and a more disciplined route from design intent to real-world progress.

Name: XL-protein GmbH
Description: XL-protein develops and commercializes its proprietary clinical-stage PASylation technology to extend the in vivo half-life of biopharmaceuticals. The genetic fusion (or chemical conjugation) with conformationally disordered amino acid sequences composed of the three small residues Pro, Ala, and/or Ser ('PASylation') provides a simple means to attach a solvated biopolymer with large hydrodynamic volume to a therapeutic protein or peptide. This polypeptide adopts a bulky random coil structure, which significantly increases the size of the biopharmaceutical. By this way the typically rapid clearance of the biologically active component via kidney filtration, or in the eye, is retarded by 1-2 orders of magnitude, depending on the length of the PAS tag. Compared with other strategies to prolong the plasma half-life of biologics PASylation technology offers a genetically encoded biopolymer with precise definition which is biochemically inert while biodegradable in the body.

Name: BioSilta
Description:
BioSilta is a privately-held, entrepreneurial company that invented the patented EnBase technology, bringing the founders’ in-depth knowledge and experience from the world of large-scale biomolecule production into the research laboratory. It all started in 2004, at the Biocenter at Oulu University in Finland. In the world of bioproduction, precise control of growth conditions is well-recognized as essential for successfully maximizing the yield and quality of products from microbial cultures. However, equipment complexity and costs associated with using large-scale bioreactors made it seemingly impossible to achieve similar success at smaller scales in the research laboratory. Then Dr. Peter Neubauer and his team decided to attempt the impossible and the idea behind the patented EnBase technology was born.
Founded in 2007 in Oulu, Finland, BioSilta is now headquartered in Cambridge, UK. The company, comprised of a multi-national group of individuals with collectively over 150 years of experience in the biotech industry, is financed by the investment companies, Omega Funds, Inveni Capital and Oulun Seudun Hyvinvointirahasto.

Today, the company’s customers are found mainly in life science research and BioSilta scientists focus their expertise on expanding the range of game-changing EnPresso growth systems.

Today, BioSilta scientists focus their expertise on utilizing the unique EnBase technology platform to develop game-changing EnPresso reagent-based, growth systems that control microbial growth. Scientists in life science research are successfully increasing yields of high quality biomolecules for their research or for NMR analysis using standard research laboratory equipment.

Name: Center of Membrane Biochemistry and Lipid Research (ZML)
Description:
The Center of Membrane Biochemistry and Lipid Research (ZML) at Technische Universität Dresden combines five interdisciplinary research groups with expertise in membrane biochemistry, lipid research, structural biology, and signal transduction. Together, we work at the interface of fundamental research and translational medicine to better understand the molecular mechanisms underlying health and disease.

Our research focuses on lipids and biological membranes: essential components of life that play key roles in cellular structure, metabolism, and signaling. We aim to systematically investigate metabolic disorders such as obesity and diabetes, as well as other complex diseases, at the molecular level and to develop new strategies for prevention, diagnosis, and therapy.

To achieve this, we combine state-of-the-art analytical, biochemical, biophysical, structural, and computational approaches with disease models and clinical studies. By closely integrating experimental research, data analysis, and clinical application, we create the foundation for innovative translational research — from molecular mechanisms to patient-oriented applications.

As an internationally connected and dynamic research center, the ZML contributes to strengthening Dresden as a leading hub for membrane biochemistry and lipid research.

Name: Cascat GmbH

Hereby, we can ensure multi-stage processes that will bring industrial production to the next level. In order to obtain stable and robust processes which can be applied in industrial scale, our enzymes are engineered towards optimal process conditions and the presence of their chemical counterparts. The use of promiscuous biocatalysts enables short cascades and reduced needs of cost intensive co-factors thus lowering production costs. Using this approach we realize synthetic cascades towards chemical building blocks, fine chemicals as well as pharmaceutical molecules.

Our aim is the realization of cost efficient, sustainable “green” processes by using energy saving and atom efficient transformations with improved down-stream processing. Our substrates are based on renewable resources, such as biomass to act in the field of bio-economy.

Name: Isarna Therapeutics GmbH
Description:
Isarna Therapeutics is a clinical stage biotech company, headquartered in Munich, Germany. Isarna develops ISTH0036, a next-generation antisense to block TGF-beta 2 production, a key molecule in the pathogenesis of retinal disease. Current therapies – approved and pipeline products – mostly target the edema, with several anti-VEGFs approved or in development offering only minor improvements over current SOC. While anti-VEGF is a very effective therapy – it does not stop the disease progression of retinal pathologies like w AMD. Patients progress to late-stage disease despite effective anti-edema therapy – and thus develop fibrosis. TGF-b is a key driver of fibrosis, so blocking the production of this molecule intracellularly, using elaborated antisense molecules, promises to be a game-changer in retina therapy. Animal data show comparable efficacy of ISTH0036 to block neovascularization as anti-VEGF – with the added benefit of suppressing fibrosis. This MOA could be an effective long-term treatment in several retinal pathologies including the blockbuster-indications wAMD, DME, RVO, with a significant upward potential in dry AMD.
A Phase 1 study showed excellent safety, Isarna Therapeutics is currently preparing a Phase 2a study in wet AMD and in DME/DR.
Isarna is led by a highly experienced management, the COO, Rene Rückert, MD, MBA led at Bayer/Novartis the global development of both approved blockbuster drugs for retinal diseases – Eylea and Lucentis. The CMO, Prof. Marion Munk, MD, PhD is a leading global retina specialist.
Isarna is open to discuss future partnering for the development and is seeking investors to finance the clinical development and growth of the company.

Description:
TheryCell brings together experts in T-cell analysis, bioinformatics, and molecular biology. Our mission is clear: to pioneer a novel therapy against various cancers based on tumor-reactive T-cells.

Our patented technology, tested in dozens of tumor samples, is actively proving the tumor-killing potential of our dedicated T-cell selections in collaborations with clinics and research institutes.

TheryCell collaborates with clinics and research institutes, combining a unique bioinformatics platform with high-throughput NGS of T-cell receptor compounds and single-cell sequencing (10Xgenomics) to manufacture dedicated, tumor-specific T-cells.

Focusing on natural tumor-specific T-cell receptors (TCRs), we identify T-cells that escaped negative selection and evolved into dominant tumor-specific T-cell clones after encountering tumor antigens.

Our proprietary technologies in immune-sequencing and special tissue handling decipher complex T-cell repertoires in the tumor (TILs). Sequencing alpha/beta TCRs provides the foundation for a tumor-specific personalized TCR-gene therapy.

TheryCell envisions a future where personalized TCR-gene therapy offers high safety and efficacy, fully compatible with the patient's individual HLA subtypes.

Description:
PRAMOMOLECULAR develops self-delivering siRNAs. Our therapeutic oligonucleotides can downregulate mRNAs in lung, pancreas, heart and colon. We are thus developing drug candidates to causally cure serious cancers such as lung, colon or pancreatic carcinoma or metabolic diseases, e.g. of the heart - as in Noonan syndrome. Currently, we are working on our preclinical in vivo proof of concept experiments.
A special feature of our technology is that we couple defined lipid residues directly to siRNAs via defined chemical bonds. This gives us one of the simplest, patent-protected platform technologies for introducing therapeutic oligonucleotides into organs besides the liver in vivo. This is of great therapeutic importance, as delivery of siRNAs has previously only worked in local applications, such as in the eye or muscle, or systemically in the liver. We are also providing siRNA based drug candidates for selected other organs.

PRAMOMOLECULAR is financially supported by the European Union from the Operational Program EFRE Berlin 2027 and by the State of Berlin.

Within the scope of the project funding, we intend to provide disease-specific drug candidates to address overexpressed or mutated RAS proteins. Misregulated RAS proteins can lead to severe metabolic diseases or cancer. We initially want to address KRAS-dependent cancers, one of the most common RAS mutations, which can lead to non-small cell lung cancer, pancreatic adenocarcinoma or melanoma.

The goal of the funded project is the provision of well-tolerated and effective therapeutics for patients suffering from non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) and pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC).

Name: immuneAdvice GmbH
Description:
immuneAdvice is biotechnology startup developing immune cell tracers (ICE-Ts) for the non-invasive detection of immune cells in the body. immuneAdvice is a spin-off of the NMI Natural and Medical Sciences Institute at the University of Tübingen and the Werner Siemens Imaging Center Tübingen.

Medical need:
immunotherapies have revolutionized cancer treatment in recent years, but their success has been severely limited by the unpredictability of individual responses. The high proportion of unsuccessful immunotherapies results not only in lost time for patients, but also in enormous additional costs for the healthcare system. In an aging society with an increasing number of cancer patients and new immunotherapies, patient stratification is essential.

Our technology:
immuneAdvice develops single domain antibody (VHHs)-based novel tracer molecules (ICE-Ts) for the detection of immune cell populations in non-invasive clinical imaging. ICE-Ts visualize the dynamic distribution of immune cells and their activation state with high spatial and temporal resolution, allowing individualized assessment of the response to immunotherapy. Our goal is to establish a therapeutic diagnostic that predicts the efficacy of current and future immunotherapies and evaluates them during therapy.

immuneAdvice is funded by EXIST - Existenzgründungen aus der Wissenschaft to complete the preclinical development of the first ICE-T. A first human trial is planned to start in 2025.

Name: OPSYON Therapeutics
Description:
OPSYON develops novel immunotherapies by combining immune checkpoint inhibition with antibody-based tumor targeting in one drug. 
The technology confines the benefits of the CD47-SIRPα immune checkpoint inhibition to tumor cells only providing cancer patients with an effective therapy with reduced systemic side effects and the possibility for long-term survival and a better quality of life.

Our molecules consist of a tumor specific antibody fused to a domain which binds to CD47 and blocks the interaction of CD47 to SIRPa, thereby inhibiting the don't eat me signal. The tumor specific antibody has high affinity for its target and serves as docking domain, whereas the CD47 blocking occurs only with low affinity and only if the the antibody has previously bound to its target on tumor cells. With this dock and block mechanism, side effects due to systemic CD47 inhibition are avoided. We use an IgG1 antibody and can therefore leverage the complete repertoire of immune cells: NK-cells and monocytes/macrophages for direct and fast tumor cell elimination and  T-cells for a prolonged anti-tumor response.

Our lead candidate OPS-121 targets the aggressive hematological disease acute myeloid leukemia (AML) and we have a solid data package demonstrating efficacy and an improved safety profile as well as manufacturability and stability studies. 
An additional pipeline candidate, OPS-301, targets solid tumors such as pancreatic and ovarian cancer.

Our vision is to make cancer treatment more effective while reducing side effects and thus improve quality of life and outcomes for cancer patients.

Developments will be challenged by and implemented in a series of eight Use Cases covering a large range of agroecosystems but also of ecosystems to demonstrate portability of solutions. Several of these Use Cases will mobilize on-farm data. A large effort will be devoted to training RI staff and beyond through a sustained collection of training material fed by experts. Outreaching activities will aim at enlarging the range of RI users. PHENET will not only strengthen RI but will also have major impact on the development of innovative companies on phenotyping, envirotyping and precision agriculture as well as on the emergence of climate smart crop varieties and innovative practices fitted to climate change and agroecological transition.

Name: AssayEngineers - Translational Immuno-Oncology
Description:
Assay Engineers is an oncology CRO specializing in ex vivo clinical response testing to predict therapeutic efficacy before first-in-human trials.

We quantify patient-specific drug response directly in functional tumor–immune systems ex vivo, enabling prediction of responder vs. non-responder profiles prior to clinical exposure.

Our platform integrates:
•	patient-derived tumor explants (AutoTILs)
•	autologous tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes (TILs) 
•	Hyperplex proteomic cell signaling pathway readouts 
•	quantitative metabolic phenotyping 

This allows direct measurement of drug-induced modulation of:
•	cell signaling pathways 
•	immune effector function 
•	tumor viability 
•	resistance mechanisms 

We generate mechanistic, multi-layered response profiles that link drug perturbation to functional outcome in the native tumor microenvironment.

In immuno-oncology programs, we preserve endogenous tumor–immune interactions to evaluate whether a therapy induces clinically relevant anti-tumor activity or fails at the functional response level.

This enables preclinical identification of:
•	likely clinical responders 
•	primary resistance patterns 
•	mechanistic failure modes 

Assay Engineers converts functional tumor biology into quantitative clinical response prediction — prior to clinical trial enrolment.

Name: BioMagnetix
Description:
At BioMagnetix, we aim to harness the incredible potential of magnetic nanoparticles naturally produced by microorganisms to bring the precision of diagnostic and therapy to a new level. 

Biologically made magnetic nanoparticles have the potential to significantly enhance the efficacy of diagnostics and treatments while reducing the side effects of medical interventions through improved imaging contrast and targeted drug delivery. 

Millions of years of evolution have shaped the unprecedented chemical and physical properties of this biogenic nanomaterial, offering a natural and sustainable solution to the production of uniform and customizable high-quality magnetic nanoparticles. 

With our expertise in the biology of magnetic nanoparticle biosynthesis, genetic engineering, and functionalization, we have the capacity to tailor such nanoparticles for a wide range of applications. We're driven by the magnetic force of innovation, committed to use the nature's gift for improving lives of millions.

Follow us on LinkedIn for more information on our progress.

Name: EpiSeedLink
Description:
The overreaching mission of EpiSeedLink is to foster a European network that empowers crop improvement through epigenetics by providing expertise, know-how, and creativity in high-end technologies to 11 early stage scientists and enabling them to translate scientific knowledge and skills into innovation. Through international, multidisciplinary, and inter-sectorial training in experimental and computational biology, EpiSeedLink will not only contribute to excellence in research but also timely address societal and agricultural needs. This original research program combines the unique know-how of academic experts with that of two seed companies to synergize research and knowledge transfer between a plant model (Arabidopsis) and a crop of enormous agroeconomic importance (oilseed rape). 
EpiSeedLink will exploit the epigenetic regulation of seed priming mechanisms to improve crop performance under threats caused by climate change (drought, heat, high light) through non-GMO practices. 
As a summary the Main Research Objectives are: 
•	to provide a “gene-to-field” applicability of new markers to produce or select varieties with an enhanced capacity for stress tolerance that, in the long term, will serve as a framework for knowledge transfer to other Brassica crops, to which various leafy vegetables, cauliflower/broccoli, mustard, and turnip belong.
 Oilseed rape is ideally suited to undertake the EpiSeedLink research program. On one hand, oilseed rape is Europe’s most important oils crop (for cereal and biofuel production) and is closely related to the model plant Arabidopsis. On the other hand, it is affected by environmental threats during the critical phases of germination and field emergence, such that the drought in 2018/19 caused up to 44% losses in the EU. The expertise of the BioAtlantis and DSV companies will beneficite as to achieve our objective.
•	 Provide excellent know-how, and improve research and complementary skills of 11 early-stage scientists

Name: Claassen Lab (University of Tübingen)
Description:
The Claassen Lab at the University of Tübingen develops explainable quantitative models in systems medicine by integrating high-dimensional single-cell omics and imaging data with machine learning and deep learning.

Our research combines experimental and computational strategies in immune and cancer biology, including custom algorithms and statistical methods for high-dimensional data and an in-house multiplexed tissue imaging platform for data generation and validation.

Name: AVA LifeScience GmbH
Description:
AVA LifeScience is dedicated to developing cutting-edge technologies for pharma- and diagnostic industry to make the world a healthier place. Our focus to date is on B-cell associated diseases with a spotlight on leukemia with the aim to establish effective companion diagnostics and precision guided therapy.

For many years, chemotherapy and radiation were the standard cancer treatments. However, these treatments are extremely unspecific, cause strong side effects and often diminish the patient’s life quality. Still today, in the age of therapeutic antibodies, existing therapies are not sufficiently targeted to distinguish healthy cells from cancerous cells. Accordingly, curative therapies with low side effects seem like a distant dream today.

With our highly specific antibodies, a novel class of unique pinpoint antibodies, AVA LifeScience can turn this dream into reality.

Aufbauend auf mehr als 25 Jahren Erfahrung in der Entwicklung hochwertiger injizierbarer Medizinprodukte und biologischer Therapiekonzepte bietet Aptissen Lösungen, die den hohen Erwartungen von Ärzten und Patienten gleichermaßen gerecht werden.

Heute bietet Aptissen ein umfassendes Portfolio orthobiologischer Lösungen an:

Synolis – moderne Viskosupplementation zur Behandlung von Arthrose
KioMedine – Single-Shot-Therapie auf Basis von Carboxymethyl-Chitosan für Patienten mit Kniearthrose
Arthrys – injizierbare Kollagenpeptid-Lösung zur Behandlung von Tendinopathien und Bandverletzungen
Tropocells PRP – fortschrittliches PRP-System für regenerative Therapien in Orthopädie und Sportmedizin
Cartylis – Nahrungsergänzung mit bioaktiven Kollagenpeptiden zur Unterstützung von Gelenk- und Knorpelgesundheit 

Getreu unserer Vision, die orthobiologische Transformation in der Behandlung muskuloskelettaler Erkrankungen voranzutreiben, stellt Aptissen den Patientennutzen in den Mittelpunkt seines Handelns. Durch die Kombination von Schweizer Qualitätsstandards, klinischer Evidenz und innovativen Technologien entwickelt das Unternehmen Lösungen, die Mobilität, Lebensqualität und langfristige Therapieergebnisse verbessern. 
Im Jahr 2023 wurde die Aptissen GmbH als eigene Niederlassung für Deutschland und Österreich in Freising bei München gegründet.

Description:
GOENOMICS provides genome annotations to help agriculture, biotech and academia to develop and better understand genomic traits for improved plants and fungi. Improving plants is important to secure worldwide food supply, by optimising for example heat resistance and resistance against nutrient and water scarcity, and agricultural pests. Better understanding fungal biology is important to treat agricultural diseases and to improve fungi for industrial drug production or waste management.

The term genome annotation summarises all steps with which each of the nucleotides of a genome sequence is given an explanation. Genome annotations are done in two steps: In the first step, all regions are identified that might have functional importance for the organism. In the second step, each of the identified regions is assigned a putative function, which is derived by comparing the region against knowledge from many databases and literature.

Genome annotations provide the base for all downstream experiments like breeding, genetics, genomics, and proteomics. By delivering high quality data, GOENOMICS enables customers to avoid needless, meaningless and unsuccessful experiments and therefore to save money.

Our product is completely safe to use for operators and the environment. The source plant species are grown commercially worldwide, enabling a scalable and commercially viable production within a short time frame. Plant material is harvested repeatedly (non-destructive) from already established resources, thus allowing side stream valorisation for the growers as well as sustainable production.

We are currently offering investors the opportunity to seed fund PlantShield to continue R&D of our prototype, kick start the registration process, and prepare resource supply to get to market ASAP. 

Why invest in the development of fungicides?
Market opportunities for effective fungicides are tremendous: they are indispensable to global food security as fungal diseases pose a major threat to crop production worldwide. Fungicide demand is forecasted to intensify due to changes in climate, fungicide resistances, and invasive fungal species. 

Why invest in PlantShield’s biological fungicide?
Environmental necessities, stricter regulations, and consumers' increasing awareness are leading to an irreversible shift towards biological fungicides in the long term. Yet, current biological fungicides face resource scarcity, high cost of refined products, and reduced efficacy – while PlantShield’s fungicide resources are abundant, its active substances easy to produce, and its initial efficacy tests point to a more than competitive product.

Name: AVATAR-Transfer
Description:
Im Kompetenzcluster AVATAR-Transfer werden Konzepte erforscht, mit denen vorhandene Gesundheitsdaten anonymisiert und somit breit genutzt werden können. Zur Datenspende für die medizinische Forschung werden gleichzeitig Anreize geschaffen. So können die Potenziale der Digitalisierung besser genutzt und die in den Datenschätzen enthaltenen Informationen besser ausgeschöpft werden. Mit diesem universellen und auf andere Branchen übertragbaren Lösungsansatz kann das Projekt einen innovativen Beitrag leisten, der die Nutzung hochsensibler, personalisierter (Gesundheits-) Daten unter Wahrung aller Datenschutzauflagen ermöglicht und bisherige Widersprüche auflöst.

Die erforschten Konzepte und Lösungen werden in einem von den beteiligten Netzwerken gemeinsam aufgebauten Reallabor/ Open Science Lab am Ende des Vorhabens unter realitätsnahen Bedingungen demonstriert und der interessierten Öffentlichkeit barrierefrei zugänglich gemacht.

In the AVATAR-Transfer competence cluster, concepts are being researched with which existing health data can be anonymized and thus widely used. At the same time, incentives are being created to donate data for medical research. In this way, the potential of digitization can be better exploited and the information contained in the data treasures can be better utilized. With this universal solution approach, which can be transferred to other industries, the project can make an innovative contribution that enables the use of highly sensitive, personalized (health) data while complying with all data protection requirements and resolving previous contradictions.

At the end of the project, the concepts and solutions researched will be demonstrated under realistic conditions in a real laboratory/Open Science Lab set up jointly by the participating networks and made accessible to the interested public without barriers.

Name: CELLinib GmbH
Description:
We found striking differences in the potency of inhibitors when assessed in vitro versus in live cells - mostly due to differences in protein expression construct used, activation state of the protein, concentration of natural competitors (e.g. ATP) and post-translational modifications present. Therefore, we found it to be crutial to assess inhibitor binding in living cells.

The method of our choice is called NanoBRET and was invented by Promega. The technique uses living HEK293T cells for a transient expression of a full-length protein kinase fused to a NanoLuciferase - that emits light upon substrate addition. In the NanoBRET assay we see a competition between a flourescently used tracer molecule and your molecule of interest - resulting in a dose-dependant decrease in Bioluminescence Resonance Energy Transfer. Becasue we use living human cells, we address the problems mentioned above: We assess the binding of your inhibitor to a full-length protein with human Post translational modifications surrounded by a cell membrane and all natural substrates (e.g. 1 mM ATP) and other binding partners that may affect the activation state.

We want to speed up your drug discovery project by quickly and accurately characterizing your small molecule inhibitor across the kinome in living cells using the NanoBRET technology. Please visit our website and/or contact us for more info! Let’s illuminate science together!

Name: Bio4Products project
Description:
The Bio4Products project will show how bio-resources can be converted into renewable alternatives to fossil-based processing streams such as bitumen, phenols and creosote. The project will demonstrate the integration of these sustainable resources into four end products: roofing material, phenolic resins, sand moulding resins, and engineered wood and natural fibre reinforced products.

The Bio4Products project has received funding from the European Union’s Horizon 2020 research and innovation programme under grant agreement No. 723070.

Innovative biomass conversion
Bio4Products will demonstrate an innovative two-step conversion method based on thermal fractionation. Treatment by fast pyrolysis will first convert the solid biomass into a bio-oil, while largely preserving the original functionalities. The next step sees the functional groups present in the bio-oil separated by fractionation, obtaining a sugar stream and a lignin stream. A fractionation demo-plant will be constructed by BTG Biomass Technology group at their facility in the Netherlands.

New bio-based products 
Bio4Products will create renewable and natural alternatives to fossil-based processing streams such as bitumen, phenols and creosote. Partners will demonstrate the integration of these sustainable resources into four end products: 
1. roofing material
2. phenolic resins 
3. sand moulding resins 
4. engineered wood and natural fibre reinforced products

The overall objective is to create four products, which, due to the replacement of fossil materials with bio-based resources, deliver a 75% reduction in greenhouse gas emissions.

Name: Smart Soil Technologies
Description:
Smart Soil Technologies creates smart substrate and fertilizer technologies to maximize crop yields in the indoor and traditional farming sectors.

Smart Soil Technologies is on a mission to tackle the most complex problems facing the global farming industry. The world needs to provide enough food for a massively growing population, but it needs to do so sustainably. Solving these challenges urgently calls for technologies that maximize crop yields while minimizing damage to the environment. 

That’s where Smart Soil Technologies comes in. With a team of experienced soil scientists, plant biologists, and minerologists, we combine nitty-gritty scientific testing with years of experience growing greens, herbs, and medicinal plants. To date, we’ve tested more than 40 proprietary biocompatible substrates to identify the best candidates for lettuce greens, basil, dill, mustard greens, spinach, and much more. Our substrates add immense value by maximizing yields for traditional greens as well simplifying the cultivation of otherwise problematic plants. 

To complement our substrate technologies, we also develop biocompatible fertilizer technologies for indoor and traditional farming. Vast amounts of traditional fertilizer application aggravate climate change. A large portion gets wasted through natural processes, thus polluting our groundwater and air. While Slow- and Controlled-Release Fertilizers intend to improve fertilizer efficiency, SCRF coatings are made of synthetic chemicals and are too expensive for industrial application. We’re revolutionizing the industry by developing natural and biodegradable slow- and controlled-release coating technologies to minimize fertilizer waste and eliminate soil pollution. 

We’re constantly innovating, iterating, and improving. That’s the only way we can meet the farming industry’s most complex challenges.

Name: Simris Biologics
Description:
Simris Biologics has developed and patented a platform through which it is capable of discovering novel cytotoxic payloads from cyanobacteria for use in Antibody Drug Conjugates (ADCs). An ADC is a "smart bomb" that is designed to kill cancer cells without harming healthy cells and thereby minimise nasty side effects and maximising both quality of life and chances of reaching remission. 

The Antibody element of the ADC is the targeting mechanism. Its job is to take the cytotoxic Drug to the target cancer cell and once there attach to the cancer cell triggering its uptake into the cell. Once inside the cancer cell, the cytotoxic Drug is released and this kills the cancer cell via a specific mode of action.

Cyanobacteria have evolved to survive in every corner of the worlf for over 3.6 billion years. To defend themselves they produce a range of cytotoxic substances from auristatins that power many of the commercially available ADCs to microcystins, which is Simris' lead programme. 

From our library of 1,200 cyanobacterial producers strains, we have been able to identify which strains produce the most potent and most selective structural analogues of microcystin. Through our unqiue technology platform we are able to feed cyanobacteria modified amino acids which they incorporate into the toxins they produce. This site directed feeding allows us to cytotoxic drugs for ADCs that are tailor made for the chemistry of the antibody and linker there are to be conjugated with. Our approach therefore enables us to produce payloads that herald the next step in the safety or cancer patients undergoing treatment. 

In a world that has become ever more synthetic it is exciting to be able to provide such effective and safe natural biologics. The natural world holds so many answers to the problems humanity faces. We just need to understand it better and find ways of working with rather than against nature.

We will start our work focusing on Glioblastoma (GBM), a primary malignant brain tumor which shows the highest incidence rate in the target group of highly lethal cancers. We will generate a unique and comprehensive GBM- data-set created out of an exclusive biobank under standardized conditions and apply it for training of a highly predictive AI-model for GBM. Model based stratification of patient groups will be used to significantly de-risk clinical trials of our future partners in the pharma industry. Beyond, the model can be used to substantially improve the development of new potent (combination) therapies. 

Once implemented for GBM, the approach will be transferred to other, currently incurable cancers with characteristics similar to GBM, forming a scalable platform.

PIRCHE is the first company to provide a patented, reliable HLA epitope matching technology and combines it with a sophisticated user interface to an outstanding web based matching system – the PIRCHE web app. This system is available 24/7, from any computer with Internet access. Name: ShapingBio
Description:
The transition to a circular bioeconomy and sustainable food systems has high potential to contribute to societal challenges such as climate change, substitution of fuel resources and to contribute to healthy food and diets, which is why innovation in the bioeconomy should be accelerated.

Although there are significant political initiatives as well as R&D and industrial activities going on, which are designed to develop the bioeconomy sector, there are still challenges in relation to getting a wider uptake of the innovation generated in the sector.

One key barrier is that actors from different sectors, such as agriculture, food and chemistry still have limited exchange with each other, and that "sectoral silos" exist. Moreover, bioeconomy is not an own dedicated policy field – the public funding and regulation is therefore scattered and partly incoherent across ministries or geographical levels.

To address these challenges the EU-funded project ShapingBio will provide concrete information and recommendations for better policy alignment and stakeholder actions to realize the cross-sectoral potential of the bioeconomy and to reduce the fragmentation across bio-based sectors and food system and policies across regions, domains and governmental levels.

Name: MAGic-MOLFUN
Description:
The MAGic-MOLFUN doctoral network (DN) will train the next generation of specialists to transform natural products research. 

The next generation of specialists will be educated in a combination of wet-lab and computational skills to integrate genome mining and metabolomics with cutting-edge pathway discovery- and engineering approaches. There is a fast-growing demand for these combinations of skills, but these are rarely taught in current integrated training programs. These multidisciplinary skills and qualifications will be acquired while achieving the scientific goals of the program, namely understanding and developing the complex biosynthesis and production of microbial NPs for cross-sector applications such as medicine, food, agriculture, or biotechnology. Specifically, the Doctoral Candidates (DCs) will work in three areas:

    1) develop novel computational tools and algorithms to improve the identification and prediction quality of biosynthetic gene clusters encoding NP biosynthesis in genomic data. This genome-centered approach is complemented by
   2)  the use of cheminformatics approaches to link metabolomics data of NPs with the genomic data of the producers, which will greatly improve the compound discovery and dereplication process. These two data-centric approaches will finally
    3) converge into experimental applications that discover and characterize novel NPs with promising bioactivities (e.g., antibiotics, pre-/probiotics, agrichemicals, bio-pigments).

The scientific training program is complemented by a comprehensive transferable skill training that will equip the DCs for todays’ demands of a successful career in industry and academia. The skills obtained in the DN will enable the DCs to work not only in natural product research but also many other data-intensive areas of biotechnology.

Name: EVANIUM
Description:
At EVANIUM, we make plant compounds like polyphenols and flavonoids more effective by improving their solubility, stability, and absorption. Our OPTISOLV Technology helps deliver natural actives into nutraceuticals, functional food, and personal care products — more effectively and efficiently.

Across the nutraceutical industry, brands face a persistent challenge: many of the most powerful botanical compounds suffer from poor water solubility and extremely low bioavailability. Even highly promising ingredients cannot deliver their full potential, resulting in underperforming products, higher required doses, and limited innovation options for formulators.

Our technology, OPTISOLV, is designed to solve this problem fundamentally. Built around a dual‐coating system, it combines an inner cyclodextrin-based core with an outer phospholipid shell, stabilizing natural ingredients in a crystal-free, highly dispersible state. This architecture prevents re-agglomeration, improves permeability, and enables dramatically higher solubility and absorption while relying solely on natural materials. For challenging actives such as Berberine, OPTISOLV increases absorption by 13× and solubility by 11× compared to the native form, outperforming even leading phospholipid-based competitors. This empowers brands to create lower-dose, higher-performance, clean-label products across a wide range of dosage formats.

We support brands in creating their next product innovation.

Name: microdrop Technologies GmbH
Description:
Microdispensing Technology for Life Sciences, IVD and Material Science.
microdrop Technologies, as the inventor of the piezo-dispensing technology, with over 30 years of experience in microdispensing, is a leading provider of non-contact microdispensing systems for life sciences, biotechnology, in vitro diagnostics (IVD), point-of-care testing (POCT), microfluidics, biosensors, lubrication and material science. 
We develop and manufacture instruments for ultra-low volume liquid handling, which are able to dispense liquids of any viscosity with high precision, accuracy and reliability.

microdrop’s dispensers are piezo-electric or valve-based, enabling highly accurate and repeatable dispensing from picoliter to low microliter volumes. Our systems support a wide range of applications, including microarray printing, lab-on-a-chip technologies, lateral flow assay, and diagnostic test manufacturing, from early-stage research and development (R&D) to automated high-throughput production.

microdrop’s microdispensing technology is optimized for precise droplet generation, droplet placement accuracy, and volume consistency, even when working with low and high viscosity liquids. 
microdrop instruments are designed for printing on any surface, filling microfluidics, biosensor surface activation and many other targets. 

As a result of the scalability, these instruments are a perfect choice from R&D till production in modern diagnostics. No system liquids, to prevent possible cross-contamination, features such as “Spot on the Fly” dispensing and integrated “QC on the Fly” monitoring. Real-time quality control, increased throughput, consistent production and no cross-contamination - this is a perfect choice not only for IVD.

Name: VAXIMM AG
Description:
VAXIMM is a privately held, Swiss/German biotech company that is developing oral T-cell immunotherapies for patients suffering from cancer. VAXIMM’s product platform is based on a live attenuated, safe, orally available bacterial vaccine strain, which is modified to stimulate patients’ cytotoxic T-cells to target specific structures of the tumor. The Company has a pipeline of complementary development candidates targeting different tumor structures.

Lead product candidate, oral VXM01, activates killer cells targeting tumor-specific vasculature and certain immune-suppressive cells, thereby increasing immune cell infiltration in solid tumors. VXM01 is currently in clinical development for several tumor types, including brain cancer. VAXIMM has completed a clinical trial evaluating VXM01 in combination with the human anti-PD-L1 antibody, avelumab, as part of a scientific collaboration with Merck KGaA, Darmstadt, Germany.
VAXIMM also has a collaboration agreement with China Medical System Holdings (CMS), granting CMS full rights in China and other Asian countries (excluding Japan) to VAXIMM’s existing programs. 

VAXIMM AG is headquartered in Basel, Switzerland. Its wholly owned subsidiary, VAXIMM GmbH, located in Mannheim, Germany, is responsible for the Company’s development activities.

Name: ComeInCell
Description:
EU Horizon Europe Funded Doctoral Network


COndensates at Membrane Scaffolds – INtegrated Systems as Synthetic CELL Compartments (ComeInCell)

ComeInCell is a European Doctoral Network at the forefront of synthetic cell research. Our mission is to develop advanced cellular mimics that integrate functional membrane structures and biomolecular condensates. By creating these next-generation synthetic cells, we aim to shed light on complex cellular mechanisms, particularly those involved in neurodegenerative diseases and membrane trafficking, as well as accelerate drug discovery and therapeutic innovation.

This ambitious project brings together a diverse team of experts in biophysics, nanotechnology, biochemistry, and bioengineering. Our doctoral candidates will receive interdisciplinary training, gaining hands-on experience with state-of-the-art methodologies and working closely with both academic institutions and industry partners.

Through ComeInCell, we’re not just advancing scientific knowledge – we’re cultivating a new generation of quantitative synthetic biologists equipped to tackle global challenges in biomedical research and biotechnology. Join us as we explore the fascinating interface between membranes and condensates, paving the way for novel therapeutic strategies and research tools!

ComeInCell is a European project funded by the European Union’s Horizon Europe research and innovation programme under the Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions. DN. It is also co-funded by UK Guarantee Scheme.

Name: Nephrolyx
Description:
Nephrolyx offers a precise and rapid measurement of the kidney function (true GFR). We provide hospitals and laboratories with an In-Vitro Diagnostic Test and a digital platform to measure the true GFR within only a few hours. 

For the first time, physicians can detect renal diseases using the highest accuracy of GFR measurement and adapt an optimal treatment plan for patients. Especially nephrology, oncology, transplantation, and ICU patients can benefit from rapid and precise diagnostics.

The Nephrolyx IVDx is indicated for the in-vitro quantitative determination of serum iohexol concentration and calculation of the glomerular filtration rate (GFR). The principle of the test is based on Ultra-High-Performance-Liquid Chromatography using Ultra-Violet light.

Proprietary technology from Nephrolyx helps to improve treatment success for kidney patients. Given its low component cost, the Nephrolyx IVDx can also significantly enhance the performance of the entire healthcare system.

Through our many regional offices, as well as our distribution centers in Vancouver, Seattle, Grenoble, and Singapore, we deliver our innovative, specialized products to more than 70 countries. 

At STEMCELL, we are dedicated to improving lives through advancing knowledge and scientific discovery, through our commitment to fostering diversity and inclusion in STEM and the life sciences industry, and through our investments in sustainability, community, and social responsibility. We do all this because we love science as much as you do.

Name: Ultragenyx
Description:
Leading with purpose. Every day.

“Ultragenyx was founded to advance innovative medicines for rare and ultrarare diseases that have never been treated before. We are delivering transformative therapies across multiple indications, and we have one of the most robust and diverse clinical pipelines in rare disease. Our focus is on doing the right things for patients both during development and commercialization to deliver on the promise of these therapies in a way that's meaningful for rare disease communities.”

Emil D. Kakkis, M.D., Ph.D.
Chief Executive Officer and President


We have an inclusive culture of value and respect.

Ultragenyx brings novel products to those living with rare and ultrarare diseases with a focus on debilitating genetic diseases. Founded in 2010, we have rapidly built a diverse portfolio of approved therapies and products aimed at diseases with a high unmet medical need for which many have no approved therapies. It takes courage, care, talent, and dedication to make a meaningful impact for those living with rare diseases, their families and the rare disease community.  

We put our people first, so they can take care of the rare disease community.

We purposefully cultivate and nurture a dynamic, supportive work environment where we encourage every team member to share their new ideas and help us unlock more possibilities. Our team is made up of exceptional and diverse people with a strong passion and commitment to helping those living with rare diseases. By embracing generosity, curiosity, inclusion, and humility we are constantly learning together—fostering an environment that supports profound growth and fulfillment.

If you want to have a meaningful impact, do the best work of your career while having fun and growing professionally and personally, come join our team!


Visit our community guidelines at: https://ultragenyx.co/community

Name: Sartorius | Bioprocess Solutions
Description:
Sartorius offers a broad portfolio of Bioprocess Solutions for all major steps of biopharmaceutical manufacturing and process development. Our bioprocess technologies support separation, purification, and concentration of biological intermediates and finished products, as well as solutions for storage and transportation.

To stay up to date with our Advanced Therapy Solutions, please follow: www.linkedin.com/showcase/sartorius-advanced-therapy-solutions

#SimplifyingProgress

Name: Promega Corporation
Description:
At Promega Corporation, creativity and connection drive discovery and innovation.

We celebrate scientific discovery and the creative application of science to solve problems. Interactions with our customers, partners and vendors are central to everything we do, and we value those relationships. We seek out and build connections across the globe and in our local communities because creative problem solving requires a network of diverse ideas and viewpoints. 

We develop and evolve technologies and instrumentation in collaboration with scientists and researchers around the globe. From simple cloning vectors used to address fundamental questions in biology to bioluminescent assays that help us monitor food safety and water quality, we work side-by-side with our partners in academic, industrial and government institutions to bring the best minds to bear on the toughest questions.

Since 1978, we have done this all with a steadfast commitment to sustainable business models that protect our environment, inspire and develop our employees as individuals, support the wellbeing and growth of our communities, and strengthen our relationships with our customers.

With 16 branches around the world, Promega products are used by a global community of life scientists who are asking fundamental questions about biological processes as well as by scientists who are applying scientific knowledge to diagnose and treat diseases, discover new therapeutics, and use genetics and DNA testing for human identification.

Name: Eurofins PSS Insourcing Solutions
Description:
Welcome to Eurofins Professional Scientific Services (PSS), where we redefine industry norms in insourcing solutions, creating unparalleled value for both our dedicated employees and esteemed clients.
Join a global leader with a 55+year legacy, mastering scientific operations and HR best practices. We place our skilled team directly at client sites, managing operations seamlessly and eliminating complexities.

Experience a transformative partnership with Eurofins PSS. We ensure a strategic, long-term service commitment that delivers value directly at your site, utilizing your facilities, equipment, and methodologies.
Whether you're an employee seeking an exceptional career journey or a company pursuing operational excellence, Eurofins PSS Insourcing Solutions is your gateway to a future where innovation, collaboration, and success converge. Welcome to a world where excellence knows no boundaries!

Name: BlueRock Therapeutics
Description: BlueRock Therapeutics is a clinical stage cell therapy company focused on creating cellular medicines to treat devastating diseases. We are harnessing the power of cell therapy to create a pipeline of new medicines for people suffering from neurological and ophthalmic diseases. Two of our novel investigational cell therapies, one for the treatment of Parkinson’s disease and one for the treatment of primary photoreceptor diseases, are clinical stage programs. BlueRock was founded in 2016 as a joint venture of Versant Ventures and Leaps by Bayer, the impact investing arm of Bayer AG that invests in paradigm-shifting breakthrough innovation. In late 2019, BlueRock became a wholly owned, independently operated subsidiary of Bayer AG. Our culture is defined by the courage to persist regardless of the challenge, the urgency to transform medicine and deliver hope, integrity guided by mission, and community-mindedness with the understanding that we are all part of something bigger than ourselves. For more information, visit www.bluerocktx.com.

Name: PrimeVigilance
Description: PrimeVigilance, an Ergomed Group company, was established in 2008 by Dr. Miroslav Reljanovic together with co-founder Dr. Elliot Brown. PrimeVigilance offers holistic, top quality, cost-effective, innovative clinical safety and PV services for pharmaceutical, biotechnology and medical device companies. Our leaders have an unrivalled reputation in the sector with a network of SMEs across the world. These include former senior regulators and consultants with expansive industry experience.

Name: CureVac
Description: CureVac (Nasdaq: CVAC) is a pioneering multinational biotech company founded in 2000 to advance the field of messenger RNA (mRNA) technology for application in human medicine. In more than two decades of developing, optimizing, and manufacturing this versatile biological molecule for medical purposes, CureVac has introduced and refined key underlying technologies that were essential to the production of mRNA vaccines against COVID-19, and is currently laying the groundwork for application of mRNA in new therapeutic areas of major unmet need. CureVac is leveraging mRNA technology, combined with advanced omics and computational tools, to design and develop off-the-shelf and personalized cancer vaccine product candidates. It also develops programs in prophylactic vaccines and in treatments that enable the human body to produce its own therapeutic proteins. Headquartered in Tübingen, Germany, CureVac also operates sites in the Netherlands, Belgium, Switzerland, and the U.S. Further information can be found at www.curevac.com.

Name: SHIMADZU CORPORATION
Description: Shimadzu Corporation has remained committed to commercializing cutting-edge technology and providing it to customers in a wide array of industries for more than 150 years. Our brand statement, "Excellence in Science", reflects our desire and attitude to diligently respond to customers' requirements by offering superior, world-class analytical and measuring instruments, medical imaging systems, aircraft equipment and industrial machinery for the advancement of human health, the safety and security of society, and industrial processes. In today’s challenging, ever-changing landscape, Shimadzu aims to partner with customers to meet their needs with unique technologies and solutions.

Name: Amicus Therapeutics
Description: Amicus Therapeutics is now part of BioMarin Pharmaceutical Inc., a leading, global rare disease biotechnology company focused on delivering medicines for people living with genetically defined conditions. For more information on BioMarin, please visit https://www.biomarin.com/ and follow @BioMarin Pharmaceutical Inc. on LinkedIn for updates.

Name: ERGOMED
Description: Established in 1997, Ergomed is a global leader in delivering specialized services in oncology, rare disease, and complex trials to the pharmaceutical and biotech sectors. Our comprehensive support covers the entire clinical trial process, from early phase to post-approval, offering full-service, industry-leading clinical trial management solutions as a trusted partner. Our integrated service model helps life sciences companies meet regulatory obligations, maximize drug development success, and enhance the patient experience.

Name: Bruker Daltonics
Description:
Bruker Daltonics delivers cutting-edge mass spectrometry solutions and workflows that help scientists and industry leaders tackle real-world challenges and make new discoveries. From life sciences and pharmaceutical research to food and contaminant analysis, environmental monitoring, forensics, and industrial quality control, our technologies and instruments provide the precision and reliability you need to make confident decisions. 

Our innovative platforms—such as timsTOF, scimaX, neofleX, and DART-TQ—combined with advanced software like SCiLSTM Lab, MetaboScape, and Biopharma Compass, transform complex data into actionable insights. Breakthrough innovations like Trapped Ion Mobility (TIMS), Omnitrap, and dual ionization GC-HRMS are redefining what’s possible in mass spectrometry. 

Trusted by leading research institutes, universities, government agencies, and industrial partners worldwide, Bruker Daltonics is committed to driving scientific progress and delivering solutions that matter. 

(For Research Use Only. Not for use in clinical diagnostic procedures)

Name: ConcertAI
Description: ConcertAI orchestrates clinical expertise, real-world data and applied AI to deliver practical intelligence for the demands of treating oncology and other complex diseases.

Name: AskBio Inc.
Description:
AskBio Inc., a wholly owned and independently operated subsidiary of Bayer AG, is a fully integrated gene therapy company dedicated to developing life-saving medicines and changing lives. The company maintains a portfolio of clinical programs across a range of neuromuscular, central nervous system, cardiovascular and metabolic disease indications with a clinical-stage pipeline that includes therapeutics for congestive heart failure, limb-girdle muscular dystrophy, multiple system atrophy, Parkinson’s disease, and Pompe disease. AskBio’s gene therapy platform includes Pro10TM, an industry-leading proprietary cell line manufacturing process, and an extensive capsid and promoter library. With global headquarters in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, and European headquarters in Edinburgh, Scotland, the company has generated hundreds of proprietary capsids and promoters, several of which have entered pre-clinical and clinical testing. Learn more at askbio.com. 

Vision - Pioneering science to create transformative molecular medicines.
Mission - Lead innovative science and drive clinical outcomes to transform people's lives.

Values:
• Be a Pioneer. We are not afraid of the impossible and to innovate to make gene therapies accessible to those in need.
• Cultivate Collaboration. Strive to be the best teammate, actively listen, openly communicate, and embrace diverse points of view.
• Embrace Responsibility. We are humbled by the enormity of our mission. We hold a relentless commitment to advance science and clinical outcomes for our patients, families, and caregivers.
• Raise the Bar. Continuously drive improvements and efficiencies. Seek and provide constructive feedback. Have a bias for learning and action.
• Act with Uncompromising Integrity. Be honest, transparent, and committed to doing what’s right in every situation. Make clear commitments and follow through.

Name: ACROBiosystems
Description:
ACROBiosystems Group, founded in 2010 and listed in 2021, is a biotechnology company aimed at being a cornerstone of the global biopharmaceutical and health industries by providing products and business models innovation. The company spans across the globe and maintains offices, R&D centers, and production bases in 12 different cities within the United States, Switzerland, England, Germany, and China. ACROBiosystems Group has established numerous long-term and stable partnerships with the world’s top pharmaceutical enterprises, including Pfizer, Novartis, and Johnson & Johnson, and numerous well-known academic institutes. The company comprises of several subsidiaries such as ACROBiosystems, bioSeedin, Condense Capital, and ACRODiagnostics.

ACROBiosystems’ brands include FLAG, Star Staining, ViruStop, Aneuro, ComboX, GENPower, and many others. Its main products and services are recombinant proteins, kits, antibodies, scientific services, and other related products. ACROBiosystems employs a strict quality control system for its products that are used in biopharmaceutical research and development, production, and clinical application. This includes targeted discovery and validation, candidate drug screening/optimization, CMC development and pilot production, preclinical research, clinical trials, commercial production, and clinical application of companion diagnostics.

Through the continuous development of new technologies and products, ACROBiosystems Group creates value for the global pharmaceutical industry and actively empowers our partners. The company is dedicated to accelerating the drug development process, including targeted therapies, immunotherapeutic drugs, and its clinical applications, and contributes to global health.

Name: CENTOGENE
Description:
CENTOGENE is a leading company in the field of genetic diagnostics and precision medicine, dedicated to transforming clinical, genetic, and biochemical data into medical solutions for patients. Based in Rostock, Germany, the company operates globally.

Founded in 2006 with the mission of revolutionizing the diagnosis of rare diseases, CENTOGENE has since scaled its capabilities to diagnose more than 2,500 rare diseases in over 100 countries, building one of the largest genetic databases in the world (1,000,000 individuals) while developing cutting-edge technology for the interpretation of genetic data. With over 350 scientific publications, CENTOGENE is a key partner for physicians in rapid and accurate genetic diagnosis, and for pharmaceutical companies focused on developing treatments for orphan diseases.

Name: Repligen Corporation
Description: Repligen, a global, bioprocessing-focused life sciences company, provides innovative solutions for the advancement of biotherapeutic manufacturing. Experts in filtration, chromatography systems, process analytics, fluid management, and proteins, Repligen is a trusted partner serving the development and manufacture of a wide range of biologics, including cell and gene therapies, mRNA, monoclonal antibodies (mAbs), antibody–drug conjugates (ADCs), bispecific antibodies, and fusion proteins. Headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, USA, Repligen operates across 22 sites, including locations in the United States, Europe, and the Asia-Pacific region.

Name: Artivion, Inc.
Description:
Artivion is a leader in the manufacturing, processing, and distribution of medical devices and implantable tissues used in cardiac and vascular surgical procedures focused on aortic repair. Our purpose is to develop simple, elegant solutions that address cardiac and vascular surgeons’ most difficult challenges in treating patients with diseases of the aorta and deliver breakthrough technologies of unsurpassed quality that have far-reaching impact. Our decades of expertise in treating aortic diseases—coupled with our recent acquisitions and partnerships—have empowered us to offer cardiac and vascular surgeons a suite of aortic-centric solutions such as cryopreserved cardiac and vascular allografts, surgical sealants, prosthetic heart valves, and aortic stents and stent-grafts.  

Artivion has over 1,600 employees worldwide with sales representation in over 100 countries. The Company has manufacturing facilities located in Atlanta, Georgia, Austin, Texas, Hechingen, Germany, and Herzliya, Israel.  Additionally, it has sales and distribution offices in various countries throughout Europe, Asia, and South America.

Description: Our mission is to improve patient lives and the sustainability of the global healthcare ecosystem by broadening the availability and accessibility of biosimilars.

Name: New England Biolabs
Description:
Established in the mid 1970's, New England Biolabs, Inc. (NEB) is the industry leader in the discovery and production of enzymes for molecular biology applications and now offers the largest selection of recombinant and native enzymes for genomic research. NEB continues to expand its product offerings into areas related to PCR, gene expression, sample preparation for next generation sequencing, synthetic biology, glycobiology, epigenetics and RNA analysis. Additionally, NEB is focused on strengthening alliances that enable new technologies to reach key market sectors, including the development of molecular diagnostics, as well as nucleic acid vaccines. New England Biolabs is a privately held company, headquartered in Ipswich, MA, and has extensive worldwide distribution through a network of exclusive distributors, agents and subsidiaries located in Australia, Canada, China, France, Germany, Japan, New Zealand, Singapore, South Korea and the UK. For more information about New England Biolabs visit www.neb.com.

Name: Bruker BioSpin
Description:
Bruker is a leading global manufacturer of analytical measurement systems for the life and material sciences. For more than 60 years, our high-performance scientific instruments as well as analytical and diagnostic solutions have enabled the study of living organisms and substances. 
Bruker BioSpin develops, manufactures, and markets instruments based on magnetic resonance technology, such as nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) spectrometers, and preclinical imaging systems. Through these world-class technologies, Bruker BioSpin is helping science and development find answers to key questions facing our society, thereby improving lives in a sustainable way.
Whether in operations, R&D, sales, or administration, our employees are at the heart of developing and manufacturing as well as selling and operating our cutting-edge and innovative technologies.

Name: Crown Bioscience
Description:
Crown Bioscience, a JSR Life Sciences company, is a global contract research organization (CRO) dedicated to accelerating drug discovery and development in oncology and immuno-oncology. We partner with biotech and pharmaceutical companies to provide innovative, tailored solutions spanning preclinical research, translational platforms, and clinical trial support. 

With the world’s largest commercially available patient-derived xenograft (PDX) collection and approximately 1,000 tumor organoid models powered by Hubrecht Organoid Technology, we offer unparalleled insights across 35 cancer indications. 

Our expertise spans in vivo, in vitro, ex vivo, and in silico methods, complemented by advanced laboratory services that span the entire drug development continuum. Additionally, our extensive biobank of liquid and human biospecimens, complete with clinical histories, enhances oncology research capabilities. 

Operating from 11 state-of-the-art facilities across the US, Europe, and APAC, our laboratories meet the highest industry standards, including accreditation by the College of American Pathologists (CAP) and the International Organization for Standardization (ISO).

To learn more, visit www.crownbio.com.

Name: Discovery Life Sciences
Description:
Discovery Life Sciences is a global leader in biospecimens and specialty lab services, enabling the discovery and development of therapeutics and diagnostics that improve patient outcomes. Our extensive portfolio of normal and diseased human biospecimens, cellular starting materials, and preclinical ADME-tox products and services accelerates research with high-quality, highly characterized materials, complemented by expertise in cell biology. Our comprehensive suite of lab services, including molecular pathology, genomics, proteomics, and flow cytometry, delivers critical data and insights for biomarker discovery across the full spectrum of retrospective and prospective clinical trials, from assay development and validation through Phase 3 and post-approval pathologist training. With a vision to be the most trusted partner in life science research and clinical development, Discovery Life Sciences is committed to advancing scientific research and transforming lives. 

Visit www.dls.com to learn more

Name: Hygiena
Description: Hygiena delivers rapid microbial detection, monitoring, and identification solutions to a wide range of industries, including food and beverage, healthcare, hospitality, pharmaceuticals, and personal care. Utilizing advanced technologies and patented designs, Hygiena provides industry-leading ATP monitoring systems, PCR-based pathogen detection and characterization systems, allergen tests, environmental collection devices, and more. Hygiena is committed to the mission of providing customers with high-quality innovative technologies that are easy-to-use and reliable, backed by excellent customer service and support. Headquartered in Camarillo, California with multiple offices around the world including United States, United Kingdom, Spain, Canada, Mexico, Australia, Brazil and China, and over 180 distributors in more than 100 countries worldwide, Hygiena branded products span the globe.

Name: Standard BioTools
Description: Standard BioTools delivers the leading proteomic and multi-omic solutions that enable researchers to discover unique biological insights not accessible by other technologies.

Name: Phastar
Description:
Phastar is an award-winning specialist biometrics and data science CRO, trusted by pharma, biotech, and medical device companies worldwide. With a global team of data specialists, it brings expertise, precision, and pace to every trial – because behind every data point is a patient waiting for treatment.
Phastar doesn’t just deliver high-quality clinical trial data. It partners with clients to turn complexity into clarity. Leveraging technology, AI-enhanced analytics, advanced statistical methods, and deep therapeutic expertise, it accelerates regulatory approvals, ensures compliance with global standards and mitigates risk. 
Phastar has a proven track record in transforming complex data into clear, actionable intelligence, empowering its partners to accelerate drug development. With scalable, tailored solutions, it expedites trials – bringing life-changing therapies to patients faster.

Name: Rentschler Biopharma
Description:
Rentschler Biopharma is a leading contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) focused exclusively on client projects. The company offers process development and manufacturing of biopharmaceuticals as well as related consulting activities, project management and regulatory support. Rentschler Biopharma's high quality is proven by its long-standing experience and excellence as a solution partner for its clients. A high-level quality management system, a well-established operational excellence philosophy and advanced technologies ensure product quality and productivity at each development and manufacturing step. Rentschler Biopharma is a family-owned company with about 1,400 employees, headquartered in Laupheim, Germany, with operations in Milford, MA, USA. 

For years, Rentschler Biopharma has supported numerous modalities on their way from concept to market, regularly contributing to biopharmaceuticals reaching market approval. In 2023 alone, we contributed to nearly 25% of all FDA-approved biologics. In 2024, the company joined the United Nations Global Compact, emphasizing Rentschler Biopharma's focus on sustainability.

Name: Immatics
Description:
Immatics is committed to making a meaningful impact on the lives of patients with cancer. We are the global leader in precision targeting of PRAME, a target expressed in more than 50 cancers. Our cutting-edge science and robust clinical pipeline form the broadest PRAME franchise with the most PRAME indications and modalities, spanning TCR T-cell therapies and TCR bispecifics.
