Lipor (PT)
The Cluster of Bioeconomy and Environment of Western Macedonia (CLuBE)(EL)
Ayuntamiento de Murcia (ES)
Stadt Münster (DE)

Name: MiBioLab (Microbial Bioprocess Lab)
Description:
On our way into a sustainable future, bioprocessing will gain importance in as a key pillar of the bioeconomy. But the implementation of bioprocesses is hindered by a cost, time and labor intensive R&D.

The MiBioLab offers contract research services and consulting in the area of bioprocess development and automation. We support industrial R&D with our automated microbioreactor plattform for accelerated bioprocess development. 
Typical tasks are strain characterization, medium and process opimization, but we also offer tailored solutions to meet your bioprocess challenges. Our experienced scientists handle your R&D task in a reliable, confidential and time-efficient manner.
Our unique technology platform with powerful robotic workflows, our bioanalytical capabilities and our expertise in experimenatal planning and data science  enable fast strain characterization and process development under production-relevant conditions (pH regulated batch and fed-batch). Our full-service package is completed by validation experiments in lab scale bioreactors.

The MiBioLab was founded in 2016 as “Helmholtz Innovation Lab“ at the Research Center Jülich with the mission to eliminate the bottleneck of time-intensive bioprocess development steps via miniaturization, automation and digitalization. With the support the Helmholtz Enterprise Spin-off Program a spin-off team was formed with the vision to build a biofoundry for Europe. 

Since April 2025, we receive support from the European Union and the state of North Rhine-Westphalia via the funding program Start-Up Transfer.NRW.  #efrenrw #jtfnrw #EUinmyRegion.

For further information take a look at our homepage. If you have any questions about MiBioLab, don't hesitate to contact us via mail  (info@mibiolab.de) or by telephone ! 

Let's optmize it!

Name: SAN Vet Europe
Description:
Whether it is veterinary diagnostics for livestock or food safety - we are your reliable partner for your individual solution.
Our competence and independence ensure our customers worldwide reliable laboratory diagnostics solutions.

Name: Detechgene
Description:
Detechgene is a spin-off of the Nephrolab of the University Hospital Cologne Medicine II. Through this collaboration it was possible to develop a cartridge system that meets all medical requirements.
In our unique cartridge system, nucleic acid detection takes place within a very short time. Not only the test speed of our product is convincing, but also a precise detection of pathogens is comparable to methods carried out in the laboratory. In addition, our cartridge system is easy to use and requires no additional equipment. Our tests can be used on site and by anyone. Our technology allows anyone to obtain a quick and accurate diagnosis. This opens up a wide variety of markets to our product, for which we can offer specific tests. Experience the revolution of on-site diagnostics with us.

Name: Calistair
Description:
The science of materials, the power of innovation

Welcome to Calistair, a pioneering chemical and material science company at the forefront of developing innovative solutions for air purification and contaminant capture. Our expertise lies in the creation of advanced catalysts and adsorbents, including zeolites, Metal-Organic Frameworks (MOFs), Zeolitic Imidazolate Frameworks (ZIFs), and Covalent Organic Frameworks (COFs).

These cutting-edge materials are integrated into a range of solutions designed to effectively treat and capture a variety of airborne biocontaminants, chemical pollutants, nerve agents, and industrial gases.

Since our inception in 2014, Calistair has been committed to pushing the boundaries of air purification technology. Our journey began with the development of the groundbreaking Calistair Technology and professional mobile air purification unit, tailored specifically for hospital environments and cleanroom environments.

In subsequent years, Calistair continued to garner recognition for its groundbreaking technology and impact on public safety. In 2020, we were honored to be selected among the top 5 Air Purification Startups Impacting Public Safety During A Pandemic, underscoring our commitment to excellence and innovation.

Today, Calistair boasts a team of dedicated specialists and researchers who are tirelessly committed to addressing environmental challenges and advancing the capabilities of our technologies in the field of material science and air purification.

Join us at Calistair as we continue to push the boundaries of innovation and set new standards for air purification and contaminant capture. Together, we’re creating a cleaner, safer world for generations to come.

Name: Vnzymes
Description: Vnzymes (Victory Enzymes GmbH) is a German biotechnology company and a subsidiary of VTR Biotech, a global biotechnology group with decades of experience in advancing bio-innovation across agricultural and industrial applications. Built on strong scientific foundations and application-driven development, Vnzymes delivers reliable enzyme and phytogenic solutions that help customers improve efficiency, performance, and sustainability in diverse production environments.

Name: ESACT - European Society for the Advancement of Cell Technology
Description:
ESACT was founded in 1976 to create a forum for the exchange of ideas on biology, biotechnology and engineering. With the purpose of gathering knowledge on the use of human and animal cells for manufacturing of biopharmaceuticals, vaccines and advanced therapies, ESACT also promotes training and education in these fields.

Our members are scientists and engineers in working in R&D in Biotec and Pharma industry, at applied science institutions and universities, in health and medical services, regulatory bodies and equipment/tools providers. 

For more details, please visit our website: https://esact.org/

Name: YMC Europe GmbH
Description:
As a research-driven chromatography specialist, YMC provides chromatographic solutions for compounds such as peptides and proteins, mAbs and ADCs as well as oligonucleotides from R&D scale through scale-up to production and final quality control in your lab. We supply innovative bio-chromatography resins and columns for preparative processes, as well as highly reproducible BioLC-(U)HPLC-columns for SEC, IEX, RP & HIC. 

Furthermore, YMC glass columns in laboratory as well as pilot scale are designed to meet bio-chromatographers’ demands. You can choose them empty as well as prepacked according to your requirements by YMC’s in-house packing service. In addition, you can make use of on-demand services for application support, screening, analytical or preparative method development. Trainings on different chromatographic topics complement the products and services.

Innovations 

The most recent and interesting developments include:
• The new standard for columns for bio purification suitable for self-packing: YMC PilotPLUS
• Next generation RP phase for peptide purification: YMC-Triart Prep Bio200 C8
• Innovative solutions for BioLC: YMC-Triart Bio (U)HPLC columns, also available in bioinert hardware

Worldwide availability and support guaranteed

YMC products are available worldwide through a dedicated support network guaranteeing qualified and meaningful practical assistance with regard to method development, method transfer, method validation, purification services and custom column packing – locally, personally and efficiently. It is not only product specifications that represent YMC quality, but the perceived ethical values of having people happily provide competent and consistent performance together with pronounced reliability even for the most difficult and demanding separations. The YMC network consists of highly focused product specialist teams to provide active support for chromatographers.

Name: Evidentic GmbH
Description:
What we do: we supply therapeutic molecules of clinical-grade quality for R&D and early drug development.

Our solution: we repackage pharmaceuticals. So, we offer aliquots of clinical-grade mAbs, bs-mAbs, fusion proteins, ADCs, and other biologics as laboratory consumables. As an additional service, we provide analytical data to accompany each aliquot.

Your advantage: you can order therapeutic molecules in clinical-grade quality as research consumables. Fast . Easy. Cost efficient.

Name: RoBoTec PTC
Description:
Producing better plants is our goal. Through our autonomous, AI-driven automated and sterile production systems, the world's plant propagators will achieve safe quality faster.
Sustainable systems from the RoBoCut family reduce CO2 emissions worldwide and enable our customers to produce onshore fairly for their own markets. 

Smart technologie

Artificial intelligence, 3D image recognition, robotics, state-of-the-art technology and software combined with a high-precision laser for dividing delicate plants - that is RoBoCut. The long-cherished dream of fully automated in vitro plant production has become reality.
The manufacturing in vitro plant production has high personnel costs and a latent risk of contamination.
For the first time and unique in the world, Friederike and Stephan von Rundstedt, together with their team of experienced plant specialists and software experts, have succeeded in achieving the seemingly impossible: one hundred percent automation of the complete in vitro production process. Cup opening, removal and plant cutting, and placing the cut plantlets on fresh medium - without a single manual operation.
Solving sterility issues once and for all. Not to mention the exorbitant costs for manual labor and and hard-to-control peaks in production. All this of course on site and at a low cost.

Better, Clean, Sterile. Plants processed with RoBoCut grow better!

People don't just propagate plants, they propagate their own mistakes. Our artificial intelligence ("AI") does not. It feeds its decisions from tens of thousands of "flawless" decisions that our experienced specialists have taught it beforehand. That's what makes the difference - and what sets us apart.

Name: PROXIDRUGS – Cluster4Future
Description: PROXIDRUGS is funded as part of the Clusters4Future Initiative by the German Federal Ministry of Education and Research (BMBF) since 2021. The cluster focuses on developing new treatments for diseases with high unmet medical needs by utilizing the new concept of targeted protein degradation. Proximity-inducing drugs can trigger the degradation of disease-relevant proteins in a highly specific manner by directing them towards the cellular recycling system. That will open up new therapeutic options in a broad spectrum of diseases. PROXIDRUGS aims at improving this novel class of drugs in multiple ways: the strategy comprises the identification of suitable functional subunits for molecule engineering; the directed optimization of pharmacological properties; and the transfer to clinical phases. In line with this, the cluster interlinks partners from academia and industry, covering the entire value chain from basic to translational research.

Name: BioAnalyt
Description: BioAnalyt develops breakthrough field-friendly technologies to enable nutrient measurement for better health outcomes. We believe that making measurement accessible to anyone and anywhere leads to improved health for all.

Name: emp Biotech GmbH
Description:
emp BIOTECH offers a wide variety of innovative products and services for labeling, purification and modification techniques, including fine chemicals, kits for labeling and purification, coupling reagents, and chemical modification services.

At emp Biotech, we challenge ourselves and our colleagues to think outside the box and work smarter. We are a dynamic, highly professional team in a company that’s growing and growing, although we still like to think of ourselves as “a big family”. Come for the science, stay for the great working environment!

Name: PICO BioScience
Description: PICO BioScience advances life science research and drug development through its proprietary Protein Interaction Coupling (PICO) technology. This platform enables high-throughput, absolute quantification of extracellular vesicles (EV), proteins, protein interactions, post-translational modifications with exceptional specificity. We provide innovative PICO Kits and tailored PICO Services to support diverse research needs, from assay development to advanced proteomic studies. Check out our products in our web shop at https://shop.actome.de or send us your request to info@picobioscience.eu!

Name: Dutscher Group
Description:
Founded in 1982, Dominique Dutscher has specialized in the distribution of consumables and laboratory equipment for research and health from the beginning. 
Dominique Dutscher SAS has grown rapidly by expanding its catalog, multiplying its services and signing distribution agreements with new suppliers who have given it their trust, paying particular attention to the quality of its service to its customers and respect for its commitments. 
From 2005, Dominique Dutscher develops internationally: 
• 2005: Creation of Dutscher Scientific UK 
• 2008: Acquisition of MC2, service company in metrology and maintenance 
• 2011: Acquisition of Milian (Switzerland) and Biosigma (Italy) 
• 2012: Acquisition of Kisker Biotech (Germany) 
• 2014: Creation of DD Biolab (Spain) 
• 2016: Acquisition of SLS (UK) 
Its strong culture of customer satisfaction, service, quality, responsiveness and tailoring is the strength of Dutscher, which is today the leading independent European group in the distribution of scientific equipment.

Name: BioContact e.V.
Description:
BioContact e.V. was founded by PhD students in 2000. 
Our goal is to provide a platform for young scientists to network with industrial companies from the field of life science, medicine and pharmaceutics.

Every year, we organize the CONTACT, one of the most important job fairs in the Rhine-Neckar region for life sciences, i.e. biology, chemistry, physics, medicine, pharmacy, and others. 
CONTACT which has more than 1,500 visitors every year provides young scientists interested in a life science career with opportunities to gather information about companies and start-ups in the fields of biotechnology, pharmacy, management consulting, and publishing and to meet their representatives in order to find out about the entry possibilities they offer. 

In addition, the volunteer members of BioContact collaborate with enterprises to organize information evenings and workshops several times a year where individual companies can personally present themselves to an interested public (“In CONTACT with”).

For more information visit our website: www.biocontact.info

Name: MONIPOL | Clinical Research
Description: Founded in 1995, MONIPOL | Clinical Research is an owner-led CRO with German and Polish roots and strong regional partnerships across Europe. Leveraging over 25 years of experience in monitoring and organizing multicenter clinical trials, MONIPOL is committed to tailored solutions for the various needs of biotechnology and small/midsize pharma companies, to support them in bringing new and innovative therapies to market. MONIPOL's offering includes the conduct of Phase I-IV clinical trials in a wide range of therapeutic areas, with a particular focus on early-phase studies.

Name: Proteome Sciences plc
Description:
Proteome Sciences plc is a specialist provider of contract proteomics services to enable drug discovery, development and biomarker identification, and employs proprietary workflows for the optimum analysis of tissues, cells and body fluids. SysQuant and TMTMS2 are unbiased methods for identifying and contextualising new targets and defining mechanisms of biological activity, while analysis using Super-Depletion and TMTcalibratorTM provides access to over 8,500 circulating plasma proteins for the discovery of disease-related biomarkers. Targeted assay development using mass spectrometry delivers high sensitivity, interference-free biomarker analyses in situations where standard ELISA assays are not available. 

We have discovered and patented a large number of novel protein biomarkers for diagnosis, prognosis and treatment of key human diseases including neurodegenerative disorders, cancer, stroke etc. and provide protein biomarker services to pharmaceutical and diagnostics companies.

We have wide experience across the life sciences sector working with many different human and animal sample types including blood plasma, CSF, solid tissues, cell culture material etc. 

As a reflection of the quality of our approach, the purpose built, state-of-the-art research facility in Frankfurt is certified to ISO 9001:2015 and GCLP

Name: Atriva Therapeutics GmbH
Description:
Atriva Therapeutics’ mission is to develop an antiviral therapy platform against severe respiratory and systemic diseases with a high unmet medical need induced by RNA viruses, e.g., influenza and COVID-19. The clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company is pioneering the development of host-targeting antiviral therapies, making development of viral resistance unlikely, and thereby significantly contributing to pandemic preparedness. The Atriva lead product zapnometinib (ATR-002) is a first-in-class, host-targeting agent that aims to inhibit viral replication and to favorably modulate the body’s immune response to RNA viruses. Atriva Therapeutics was founded in 2015 in Tübingen by a team of leading scientists in viral research and seasoned industry experts and is based in Tübingen, Frankfurt, and Martinsried (IZB, near Munich), Germany.

Atriva is a founding member of the BEAT-COV initiative. www.beat-cov.de
For further information, please visit www.atriva-therapeutics.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Twitter (@AtrivaTx).

Name: Primogene GmbH
Description:
Primogene GmbH is a biotechnology company based in Leipzig, Germany. We develop bioprocesses to manufacture functional ingredients based on multi-enzyme systems. Our ingredients are used for nutrition, personal care and as raw materials for pharma purposes, to support life’s journey, from the first breath to the golden years.



Note: Co-funded by the European Union. This project is co-financed from tax revenues on the basis of the budget adopted by the Saxon State Parliament.

Name: AICROS
Description:
AICROS, the Association of International CROs, is an official operative network of small to midsize CROs which provide clinical research services for the medical device, pharmaceutical and biotech industry for many years. 

Through our experience we fully understand the needs of Sponsors, we always find time to listen their requirements, their wishes and their typical complaints about the CRO business. 

We have learned that low quality providers - slow but expensive global CROs - are missing client orientation, high staff turnover or just lack of CRO staff competence therefore they caused frustration in the past experience of our clients. 

Everybody considers small to midsize CROs as much better service providers, however Sponsors are less confident that they can handle multinational trials. Based on this knowledge we decided to follow a different approach which combines the advantages of large and small to midsize CROs and offering the reliability of a global CRO.

Name: T-CURX GmbH
Description:
T-CURX is a Biotech company, spun-out from the University Clinics Würzburg, Germany, developing first- and best-in-class personalized immunotherapies on the basis of CAR-T cells. CAR-T cells are a transformative, one-shot, chemotherapy-free targeted and personalized cancer treatment. 
T-CURX has exclusive licenses for proprietary technologies and CAR-T product opportunities developed in the laboratory of Prof. M. Hudecek, Würzburg, Germany one of the leading European clinical CAR-T cell laboratories.

T-CURX leverages several cutting-edge CAR-T engineering technologies, including virus-free transposon based genetic engineering and a highly flexible and modular CAR format. This provides unparalleled flexibility, efficacy, safety, but also scalability for developing CAR-T cells at significantly lower costs than conventional lentivirus-based CAR-T cell manufacturing.

This technology enables building discrete objects with user-defined shapes and mechanical properties on the scale of 10 to 1000 nanometers from the bottom-up. These objects are similar in scale to natural macromolecular particles that are found inside and outside of living cells. User-defined chemical and mechanical features can be positioned with near-atomical control, and DNA origami objects can be assembled into macroscopic materials with novel mechanical or optical properties. Because of these capabilities, DNA origami is an enabling technology that creates new and unparalleled opportunities toward the construction of “bionano” products that promise tremendous technological progress in areas such as biology, chemistry, physics, nanotechnology, and health care.

About Biosimilars:

Since their introduction in the 1980s, biopharmaceutical drugs have revolutionized the treatment of serious and chronic diseases. By 2032, many of these drugs will lose their patent protection – including 45 blockbusters with an estimated total annual global turnover of more than 200 billion US dollars. Biosimilars are successor products to biopharmaceutical drugs for which market exclusivity has expired. They are approved in highly regulated markets such as the EU, the USA, Canada, Japan and Australia in accordance with strict regulatory procedures. Biosimilars create competition and thus give more patients access to biopharmaceutical therapies. At the same time, they reduce costs for healthcare systems. Global sales of biosimilars currently amount to around 21 billion US dollars. Analysts assume that sales could rise to over 74 billion US dollars by 2030.

Description:
Agena Bioscience empowers research laboratories worldwide to deliver scalable targeted genomic data. Headquartered in San Diego, with offices located around the world, Agena Bioscience fosters a highly collaborative culture for both our customers and employees, encouraging diversity, creativity, and most importantly, innovation.

Name: altona Diagnostics
Description:

Name: DISPENDIX
Description:
WE ARE CREATING THE FUTURE OF HEALTH
DISPENDIX provides premium liquid handling technology to scientists and lab technicians around the world, and is creating the future of medicine. Liquid handling technology enables new discoveries in areas such as drug development, diagnostics and synthetic biology. We believe that technological advances and science are made for each other. Good technology simplifies science. DISPENDIX GmbH, the premier provider of noncontact liquid handling solutions in the nano to microliter range, started out in 2016 as a spin-off from the Fraunhofer Institute for Manufacturing Engineering and Automation (IPA) in Stuttgart, Germany. In 2018, DISPENDIX joined the world’s leading bio convergence company BICO, which now encompasses 900+ colleagues and 11 companies, offering a portfolio of technologies, products and services to create the future of health. Name: AMSilk | Biogenius Materials
Description: AMSilk's Biogenius Materials made from silk proteins are setting new standards in material innovation. Using cutting-edge science and the most advanced technologies like DNA edition, protein engineering and precision fermentation, we transform biogenic materials inspired by nature into groundbreaking Biongenius Materials. At AMSilk, we turn man-made proteins into formulations, including fibers and yarns, hydrogels and silk powder. The high-performance qualities of our material enable a wide range of applications in the textile, homecare, biomedical, and automobile industries and bring breakthrough benefits for products and customers. Privacy Policy: See our website.

Name: NVision Quantum Technologies
Description:
NVision is pioneering a new generation of quantum systems designed to bring quantum computing and quantum sensing out of the lab and into the real world, transforming how diseases are understood, detected, and treated.

We engineer and control the quantum properties of organic molecules, integrating molecular design and quantum hardware into scalable products.

Our POLARIS platform uses quantum-based hyperpolarization to enable real-time metabolic MRI with more than 10,000x signal enhancement, supporting non-invasive, early-stage disease detection and treatment monitoring.

We also introduced PIQC (Photonic Integrated Quantum Circuits), a fundamentally new quantum computing architecture that combines molecular qubits with photonic integrated circuits to enable scalable biological modeling and next generation drug discovery.

At NVision, we see these technologies converging into a new “compute and validate” paradigm, where quantum systems are used both to design therapies and to measure their biological impact.

Name: CliniSciences Group
Description:
CliniSciences commercialises reagents (antibodies, recombinants, ELISA kits, RNAi, cDNA clones, probes, PCR/qPCR reagents...) to diagnostic and research labs. Description: The Fraunhofer Institute for Cell Therapy and Immunology IZI investigates and develops specific problem solutions at the interfaces of medicine, life sciences and engineering. The Institute practices contract research for biotechnological, pharmaceutical and medical-technological companies, hospitals, diagnostic laboratories and research facilities. Within the Business Units of Agents, Cell Therapy, Diagnostic and Biobanking, the Institute develops, optimizes and validates methods, materials and products. The Institute's core competencies are located in the field of Regenerative Medicine, in particular in the indication areas of oncology, ischemia and autoimmune, inflammatory and infectious diseases. The Institute is clinically oriented and conducts quality checks and the GMP-compliant manufacture of investigational medicinal products. Moreover, the Institute provides support in obtaining manufacturing authorizations and approvals.

Name: Axolabs
Description:
Axolabs specialises in a new class of drugs whose active ingredients are chemically derived from DNA or RNA. They are called oligonucleotide or nucleic acid therapeutics. We use our many years of expertise to help our clients make them a success. Some of these drugs have already been approved and are being used successfully against diseases that were previously untreatable in some cases. New drugs from this class are added every year.

Axolabs is part of the LGC Group. Its business unit for nucleic acid therapeutics is combined under the brand name Axolabs.

Axolabs operates companies in the following locations: 

Axolabs, Kulmbach, Germany

The site will be dedicated to medium to large scale and early to late phase clinical GMP manufacturing of nucleic acid therapeutics. The state-of-the-art facility will deliver integrated analytical and manufacturing solutions. The operational start date is scheduled for 2025.

Name: ibidi GmbH
Description:
Innovative Solutions for Microscopy 

ibidi is a global leader in the development and supply of functional, cell-based assays and advanced products for cell microscopy. Our comprehensive portfolio includes a wide range of μ-Slides, μ-Dishes, and μ-Plates, offering robust solutions for both standard cell culture applications and complex biological assays such as angiogenesis, chemotaxis, wound healing, shear stress, and flow dynamics.

In addition to consumables, ibidi provides advanced instrumentation, including precision heating and incubation systems, as well as a unique perfusion system that simulates physiological flow conditions, such as those found in blood vessels. All ibidi products are designed with high-end microscopy in mind, ensuring optimal results for phase contrast, DIC, fluorescence, and confocal imaging.

Our innovations have been recognized with numerous awards. In 2013, ibidi received the “Innovationspreis der Deutschen Wirtschaft” (Innovation Award of the German Economy), and in 2016, the “Germany – Land of Ideas” award for excellence in scientific collaboration. In 2021, Pharma Tech Outlook named ibidi one of the Top 10 Virology Solution Companies in Europe, and in 2023, Healthcare Tech Outlook recognized ibidi as one of the Top 10 Oncology Solution Providers in Europe for its pioneering technologies in cancer research.

Name: Lipotype
Description:

Life science researchers from biotech and pharma, food industry, cosmetics and dermatology as well as academia fuel their research with Lipotype  Lipidomics.

Lipotype is a spin-off company from the Kai Simons and Andrej Shevchenko labs of the world-renowned Max-Planck-Institute of Molecular Cell Biology and Genetics in Dresden, Germany.

Lipotype - Lipidomics for a better life

Name: Pig Improvement Company (PIC) - Europe

Name: Exosome Diagnostics, a subsidiary of mdxhealth
Description:
Exosome Diagnostics, Inc., a subsidiary of mdxhealth, is commercializing minimally invasive molecular diagnostics in blood and urine to enable doctors to select optimal therapies for cancer and other diseases. 
 
Exosomes are lipid bilayer covered microvesicles shed by solid tumors into body fluids, such as blood and urine.  Exosomes contain nucleic acid profiles of cancers and other diseases.  In published studies, Exosome Diagnostics has demonstrated the ability to extract exosomes from the blood and urine of patients, and to detect with high sensitivity and specificity key genes and gene mutations associated with a variety of cancers.

Name: Reaction Biology

Name: T-knife Therapeutics
Description:
T-knife is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing next-generation engineered T cell therapies and in vivo cell therapies for solid tumors. The company combines proprietary engager technology, synthetic biology, and a deep understanding of solid tumors to create armored supercharged T cell therapies designed to achieve broad, deep, and durable responses for patients in high unmet-need indications.

T-knife’s lead oncology program, TK-6302, is a potentially best-in-class engineered TCR-T cell therapy targeting PRAME, a clinically validated cancer antigen expressed across multiple high-value solid tumor indications, including ovarian cancer, melanoma, non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), endometrial cancer, and triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC). TK-6302 has been specifically designed to overcome barriers in the solid tumor microenvironment leading to improved persistence of highly functional T-cells.
T-knife is also advancing two proprietary in vivo cell therapy programs for solid tumors aimed at reprogramming immune cells directly within the patient. These first- and best-in-class in vivo T cell therapy candidates are leveraging the company's broad solid tumors technology toolbox and incorporate innovative designs to improve in vivo cell therapy efficacy in solid tumors.

Founded by leading experts in T cell biology, immunology, and cancer immunotherapy, T-knife was built on pioneering research from the Max Delbrück Center for Molecular Medicine and Charité – Universitätsmedizin Berlin. The company is led by an experienced biotech leadership team and backed by leading global life science investors, including Andera Partners, EQT Life Sciences, RA Capital Management, and Versant Ventures.

Name: Heidelberg Pharma AG
Description:
Heidelberg Pharma is a biopharmaceutical company working on a new treatment approach in oncology and developing novel drugs based on its ADC technologies for the targeted and highly effective treatment of cancer. ADCs are antibody-drug conjugates that combine the specificity of antibodies with the efficacy of toxins to fight cancer. Selected antibodies are loaded with cytotoxic compounds, the so-called payloads, that are transported into diseased cells. Inside the cells, the toxins then unleash their effect and kill the diseased cells. 
Heidelberg Pharma uses several compounds and has built up an ADC toolbox that overcomes tumor resistance via numerous pathways and addresses different types of cancer using various antibodies. The goal is to develop targeted and highly effective ADCs for the treatment of a variety of malignant hematologic and solid tumors.
The company is listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange (FSE: HPHA). More information is available at www.heidelberg-pharma.com.

Name: SCIENION
Description:
SCIENION is the leading manufacturer of robust, high performance dispensing automation for applications requiring precise deposition of biological content in ultra-low volumes.  Our non-contact technology is ideally suited for loading of oligonucleotides, proteins, antibodies, and glycans onto diagnostics devices.  Enabled by very flexible software, our systems are used from early R&D activities, all the way through to manufacturing millions of devices per year.  Easy scale up is facilitated by the fact that the same core technologies are engineered into all of our systems. 

In our portoflio, SCIENION also offers a line of readers, optimized for quantitative array reading on both slides and microtiter plates.  Available in colorimetric and fluorescence, these readers are designed with the goal to surpass all pre-existing commercial readers and become the industry standard for assay kits in central labs. 

Additionally, through our subsidiary Cellenion, we have developed new technology enabling the dispensing of single-cells.  The ability to manipulate single-cells has long been a challenge for the scientific community due to their micrometric size and delicate nature. We have developed and patented a breakthrough technology called cellenONE, allowing high throughput isolation and dispensing of single cells onto a wide range of substrates. 

We also offer our assay development and contract manufacturing services, offering a spectrum of full solutions involving the full manufacturing process including wafer prep, surface functionalization, dicing, content spotting, QC, cartridge assembly, functional QC, and packaging.

Name: biosaxony e.V.

It pulls the different strands of biotech and medtech together, gauges its members’ needs, and represents their interests. biosaxony’s responsibilities include initiating projects between industry and research, pinpointing services and know-how, harnessing synergies, and highlighting regional expertise in order to support the value-added development of these cross-cutting technologies. Other elements of its cluster work include developing new ideas and strategies as well promoting sustainable technology transfer, such as at its partnering conference bionection. Local work is strengthened by biosaxony’s two offices in Leipzig and Dresden.
In 2016, biosaxony set up the Section Medical Technology. Combining biotechnology with medical technology is intended to enable new areas of innovation to be identified, network actors from different fields, and hence lastingly strengthen the regional economic structure of both sectors.

Name: Affimed
Description:
Affimed N.V. (Nasdaq: AFMD) is a clinical-stage immuno-oncology company committed to giving patients back their innate ability to fight cancer by actualizing the untapped potential of the innate immune system. The company’s Innate Cell Engagers (ICE), generated from its proprietary ROCK platform, are bispecific antibodies, which target innate immune cells, e.g. natural killer (NK) cells and macrophages, to destroy tumor cells. Affimed’s ICE enable a tumor-targeted approach to recognize and kill a range of hematologic and solid tumors with activity demonstrated as monotherapy and when given in combination with NK cells and other I-O therapeutics. Affimed has three active clinical programs focused on solid tumors and blood cancers. 

The lead candidate Acimtamig (AFM13) is in development for patients with CD30-positive lymphomas. Acimtamig combined with NK cells has demonstrated high objective response rates in heavily pretreated, relapsed / refractory (r/r) Hodkin lymphoma (HL) patients with a manageable safety profile in a clinical trial (AFM13-104). Affimed’s phase 2 study, LuminICE-203, is underway to investigate acimtamig in combination with AlloNK (also known as AB-101), an off-the-shelf, allogeneic NK cell from Artiva Biotherapeutics, in patients with r/r HL with an exploratory arm planned in patients with r/r/ peripheral T-cell lymphoma (PTCL). 

AFM24 is in development for epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR)-expressing solid tumors. Based on the data generated to date, the developmental focus of AFM24 is in combination with the anti-PD-L1 inhibitor atezolizumab in advanced stage EGFR-positive non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). 

AFM28 is being developed for patients with CD123-expressing acute myeloid leukemia (AML) in need of new therapeutic options. A first-in-human Phase 1 clinical study is underway (AFM28-101) and development in combination with allogeneic NK cell therapy is being explored.

Offering standard and fully customizable analytical and logistics services across a variety of therapeutic areas, we add value at every stage of the drug development process, from nonclinical and preclinical through phase IV clinical trials. Each therapeutic area is supplemented extensively by different models and batteries of in vitro and ex vivo analyses, offering answers to your therapeutics’ effect on over 900+ parameters while accelerating your research programs. With our strong reputation for scientific expertise, passionate approach to customer care, and adherence to quality data, we empower clients ranging from emerging biotech to Top Ten Global Pharma companies to reach confident clinical decisions that ultimately serve to improve patient lives.

Name: BioLabs Heidelberg
Description:
BioLabs Heidelberg is designed with life science entrepreneurs in mind by combining premium, fully-equipped laboratory and office space with unparalleled access to capital and industry partners.
On-demand, flexible spaces allow startups to rent only what they need, from a single bench to a private suite, and to scale space as the company grows.

Name: Nucleate Germany
Description: Nucleate is a nonprofit organization dedicated to empowering the next generation of biotech leaders. We believe that the grand challenges of our time will be solved by the academics who transform experiments into enterprises. Nucleate removes barriers so they can concentrate on building transformational technologies.

Name: BMG LABTECH
Description:
BMG LABTECH is a leading developer and manufacturer of microplate reader instrumentation with a wide range of measurement methods. Microplate readers are used in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries, as well as in academic research establishments, for both basic research analysis and high-throughput screening. We focus solely on microplate readers and offers the most diverse selection of optical detection systems in conjunction with integrated liquid handling equipment.

Our exceptional worldwide sales and support network is committed to bringing you innovative microplate reader technology with the reliability and quality that you expect from BMG LABTECH.

The highest priority at BMG LABTECH is to have satisfied microplate reader customers! We succeed at this goal by not only offering excellent microplate readers but also providing personal customer support that not found at larger companies. Our support centers have teams of microplate reader development specialists ready to work with you and your applications to get the most out of your microplate reader. This close working relationship allows BMG LABTECH to completely understand your needs and to help develop our instruments to meet the changing needs of the microplate reader market.

Imprint: https://www.bmglabtech.com/legal-notice/
Privacy Policy: https://www.bmglabtech.com/privacy-statement-linkedin/

Name: Cube Biotech
Description:
Cube Biotech is a contract research organization of membrane protein scientists offering non-GMP services for many applications. We assist in protein preparation, biophysical target characterization, and structure determination by cryo-EM or assay development.

Our USP is a vast synthetic copolymer portfolio, enabling more reliable membrane protein research. Copolymers offer, in contrast to detergents, a broad and native picture of your target. 

Discover endless customization possibilities with our Protein Services – your project, your way, as easy as building with Lego bricks! Build frameworks that are easily incorporated into your own processes. Choose between FTE-based, fee-for-service-based, and milestone-based models.

We are looking for long-term collaborations with industrial and academic partners. Contact us to learn more.

Name: Insempra
Description:
Insempra is a biology-powered company enabling businesses to make superior products with nature. We combine bioscience and technology to grow matter for new and better products.
For too long, businesses have relied on chemical industrialization processes and petrochemicals, depleting our planet’s limited resources. That’s why we are committed to drive the regenerative revolution to manufacture at scale in collaboration with nature.

Led by a hand-picked team of biologists, technologists and entrepreneurs with rebel hearts, Insempra is here to create a new school of thought and collective action. The time to restore the balance between people and the planet is now. We don't wait for change. We do what needs to be done to grow a better future.

To learn more about Insempra click the link in our bio to visit our website.

We are committed to driving the regenerative revolution to manufacture at scale in collaboration with nature.

Name: Iris Biotech GmbH
Description:
Starting in 2001 with a small range of commodities for peptides, Iris Biotech GmbH developed its portfolio to a unique list of standard reagents and unusual building blocks extended by our custom synthesis service making us the number one address for any (un-)usual compound required for the modification of peptides.

Our mission as qualified supplier is to support our customers in their ongoing projects from research scale to commercial production by providing our know-how and latest products together with the required analytics and documentation. 

In the field of drug discovery, we offer protected amino acids, coupling reagents, linkers und resins, natural and unusual amino acids and their derivatives, fatty acid derivatives, as well as thousands of other building blocks and resins. 

Regarding drug delivery, Iris Biotech provides the world’s largest portfolio on PEGylation reagents ranging from short, monodisperse hydrophilic linkers, to very long, polydisperse derivatives. Next to those pioneer products, Iris Biotech presents novel polymers with improved biodegradability. As part of our new section Linkerology we provide PROTAC* building blocks as well as various functionalized linkers – depending on the desired application either with a predetermined breaking point or defined stability. Further additions are fullerenes, showing distinct photo-/electrochemical and physical properties thus being useful tools for various fields of research, e.g. as antioxidant, as radical scavenger, for filling hydrophobic binding pockets, or as carrier in drug delivery.

Life Sciences – our latest field of activities – include inhibitors, metabolites, substrates, and fluorescent dyes. Furthermore, we offer natural products with biological and pharmaceutical activity, carbohydrates, as well as Amadori and Maillard reaction products. 

* PROTAC is a registered trademark of Arvinas Operations, Inc. and is used under license.

Please contact us for further information.

Name: MyMicrobiome - The microbiome company
Description:
Microbiome-friendly is the only registered certification mark for Microbiome-friendly cosmetics, ingredients, hygienic products, pharmaceuticals, textiles and pet care.

Our independent product certification guarantees the Microbiome-friendliness of your products and provides full legal protection. 

Having tested more than 1000 Microbiome-friendly products from 150 global brands, we are proud to be the leading industry standard for Microbiome-friendly certification.
Our head office is located in Switzerland with further subsidiaries in Bavaria / Germany, Thailand and Norway. 

"We are a committed team of scientists, creative minds and visionaries. Our enthusiasm for the future-oriented topic of the microbiome knows no bounds." 

Dr. Kristin Neumann, Co-Founder & CSO

For a better Microbiome-friendly world!

Name: Medicover Genetics
Description:
Medicover Genetics is a network of laboratories and medical institutions with over two decades of expertise in genetic testing. From our home base in Germany, our team is continuously developing and updating an in-house and tailormade portfolio which is offered internationally in the areas of oncology, rare disease diagnostics, reproductive health, and whole-exome sequencing.
Our genetic testing is supported by genetic counselling, to help health care professionals identify the right genetic test for their patients while empowering people to use meaningful genetic tests at the forefront of their diagnostic journey.

Name: Gold Standard Diagnostics Industrial Solutions
Description:
Gold Standard Diagnostics is a global provider of diagnostic test kits, lab consumables and automation solutions in the fields of bioanalytical testing for the food, feed, environmental, biopharma, animal health, and clinical industries. We are engaged in the innovative development, quality manufacturing, and the outstanding commercialization of our solutions. 
Our company aims to become an innovative and trusted solution provider for all our stakeholders, and strives to simplify and improve customer experience.

Name: Starlab
Description:
We believe in progress through science. Our solutions enable bright minds to change the world.

We are “Passionate for Science”. Since 1998. Our product portfolio specializes in the field of Liquid Handling Technology and laboratory products. Our product portfolio includes laboratory consumables such as pipette tips, single and multi-channel pipettes, cell culture, tubes, PCR consumables, nitrile and latex gloves, and benchtop equipment for general laboratory use.

Our products and services are in daily use at research institutions in biological and medical institutes, universities and hospitals, as well as in companies in the life sciences. We have earned an excellent reputation within the research community as a consultative company who takes a structured approach to Liquid Handling products and support. We work very closely with our customer network to continuously improve the products we offer, and to seek out new opportunities both from a product and support perspective. We have become a significant market player in all the product and service areas where we focus our efforts. Our success is due to our highly-trained and motivated staff and a portfolio of high quality products and services.

STARLAB are liquid handling experts, with many years’ experience in automated injection moulding processes for the manufacture and sale of high quality laboratory consumables for research and development. With TipOne we have developed one of the world's leading pipette tip systems. Quality, price and service are STARLAB’s core principles

STARLAB is based in Germany, the United Kingdom, France and Italy, for the direct sales of our extensive product range. In addition, regional partners in many countries allow the purchase of STARLAB products throughout the world.

Name: Cellular Technology Limited — CTL
Description:
Cellular Technology Limited (CTL) has been pioneering the ELISPOT technology for immune monitoring. For nearly 20 years, CTL’s mission has been “Elevating ELISPOT to an Exact Science”. Serving over 2,000 clients from academia and industry worldwide, CTL offers unparalleled expertise in immune monitoring. We offer:

Contract Laboratory:  
Immune monitoring with an emphasis on T and B cells in a 
CLIA-certified, GLP-compliant laboratory with processing capabilities of up to 450 samples per week. Assays include:  ELISPOT, ELISA, FACS, CBA, Proliferation, and more. Comprehensive solutions for sample processing:  Whole blood processing with 
optimized PBMC cryopreservation methods that ensure good cell functionality.

All-around ELISPOT including:
– Protocols and reagents for human PBMC cryopreservation, processing, and testing
– Human PBMC reference samples as reference standards for assay performance.
– Extensive Cryopreserved PBMC Library:  The largest commercially available library of donors available both uncharacterized and with established T cell reactivity.
– ImmunoSpot Kits: Standardized T Cell and B Cell ELISPOT Kits. Single- and Double-color Enzymatic ELISPOT. Up to Four-color T Cell & B Cell FluoroSpot Kits. Cytokine/Antibody combination multicolor FluoroSpot Kits.
– Non-radioactive human Natural Killer/ADCC Assessment Kits
– Positive and negative control antigens.
– Consultation and Hands-on Workshop Training on the use of ELISPOT for immune monitoring.
– ImmunoSpot Analyzers for automated and objective ELISPOT data analysis and streamlined data processing with audit trails.
– BioSpot Analyzers for serum antibody neutralization tests; Viral Plaque, PRNT, Viral ICA, Serum Neutralization Assays, and Serum Bactericidal Assays, all with multicolor capability.
– Serum-free Media for washing, testing, and freezing PBMC
– Plate Scanning and Analysis Services

Name: BIO Deutschland e. V.
Description:
BIO Deutschland is the sector association of the biotechnology industry and has set itself the goal of supporting the development of an innovative branch of industry based on modern life sciences. The association has around 350 member companies and organizations and numerous national and international partners.

Cheese, wine, beer and bread, but also cancer drugs, pregnancy tests, detergents and jeans: all these products are created with the help of biotechnology. Further information can be found in our so-called Biothek here: https://www.biodeutschland.org/de/biothek.html

Name: CatalYm GmbH
Description: CatalYm is a biotechnology company committed to developing innovative immunotherapies for cancer patients. CatalYm has identified GDF-15 as a central regulator of the immune system in the tumor microenvironment and translates the therapeutic potential of neutralizing GDF-15 into meaningful clinical responses for patients with solid tumors. CatalYms CTL-002 program is poised to demonstrate clinical proof-of-concept in multiple solid tumor indications and has the potential to expand the treatment horizon for current and future immunotherapies.

Name: Phytobiotics GmbH
Description: Phytobiotics demonstrates one of the fastest growing global companies serving the animal production industry. The company produces and distributes innovative phytogenic supplements, flavors and organically bound trace elements. In addition to feed additives, Phytobiotics also provides consultative services focused on intestinal health, stress reduction, and increased nutrient bioavailability for a wide array of animal species.

Name: Molecule
Description: We propel science from lab to life, fuelled by a community committed to human progress.

Name: Tebubio
Description:
We facilitate Life Sciences Research every day, contributing to advance Science for a brighter future. Through our local offices located across Europe, we support Life Sciences and Biotechnology Researchers with a unique, holistic range of solutions to advance their projects faster:

- We enable researchers to be at the forefront in their Research with access to cutting-edge biological solutions sourced from reputed global Life Sciences suppliers, carefully selected by our Scientific Team for their relevance and evaluated for their ethical and legal compliance. 

- We accelerate their Research thanks to our Contract Research Services’ strong expertise in mRNA production & delivery, cell line engineering & protein production, cellular studies and biomarkers analysis when they lack time, routine practice or expertise.

With Tebubio, concentrate your efforts and accelerate what’s most important to you: Your Research.

Name: PromoCell
Description:
At PromoCell, we help scientists do better research with a world-class portfolio of human primary, stem and blood cells as well as optimized cell culture media. With over 35 years of expertise, we are recognized globally for supplying scientists with the tools and support they need to do groundbreaking research.

All our products comply with European biomedical conventions, ensuring human rights and donor privacy are always protected. Our ISO certifications demonstrate our absolute commitment to quality and our EXCiPACTTM GMP certification enables us to produce our cell culture media and reagents according to GMP standards as a manufacturer of pharmaceutical excipients.

Each year 600 peer-reviewed publications feature PromoCell products. We operate in over 36 countries around the world, helping scientists with all of their research needs. 

Complete imprint: http://www.promocell.com/imprint/
Privacy Policy: http://www.promocell.com/privacy-policy/

Name: Markes
Description:
Markes, a Velaris brand, is a world-leading developer of technologies that enhance the analytical power of GC for both routine & research work. Its award-winning thermal desorption & automated sample extraction/concentration systems enable highly sensitive trace-level analysis of volatile & semi-volatile organic compounds across gases, liquids & solids. These capabilities are complemented by its subsidiary, SepSolve, which supplies advanced GC and GC×GC platforms, TOF MS & specialist software for data mining, chemometrics & chromatogram comparison.
 
Together, Markes and SepSolve deliver integrated workflows from sampling to confident data interpretation, supporting laboratories working in environmental monitoring, materials testing, food/beverage analysis, flavour and fragrance chemistry & clinical research.

Name: Minitube International
Description:
Minitube International is the world’s leading system supplier for reproduction technology in farm animals, specializing in artificial insemination, embryo transfer, and related biotechnologies. One of Minitube International’s goals is to increase efficiency and animal welfare in livestock management using technology and science. At Minitube, veterinarians, engineers, and researchers work together on the continuing development of animal breeding technologies to provide customers with solutions resulting in measurable success. In this way, Minitube International also contributes, in partnership with its customers, to the sustainable production of healthy and affordable food.

Since 2021, Minitube is also serving customers in human reproductive medicine directly under the “Minitube Human ART” brand. The company has been developing and manufacturing products for cryopreservation, cryo-storage, and other IVF applications for more than 40 years. Further information and news on this area can be found on Minitube Human ART's own LinkedIn channel and on the dedicated website www.minitube-humanart.com.

Minitube International is a closely held company that reflects the values and strengths of a family-owned business. Headquartered in Tiefenbach, Germany, Minitube International serves customers worldwide and works closely with highly trained local representatives, subsidiaries, and distributors in more than 100 countries.

Name: Texcell
Description:
About Texcell

We are a specialized CRO supporting biologics, vaccines, medical devices, cell and gene therapies, and other complex biological products. Our core expertise includes viral safety, viral clearance, biosafety testing, custom cell culture, cell banking support, and bioassays.

For more than 30 years, clients have trusted Texcell for scientific rigor, responsive partnership, and practical support when programs need clarity. We design studies, solve technical questions, assess product safety, and move development programs forward with confidence.

Our services include:

Viral safety and biosafety testing for biological products, cell banks, raw materials, and cell-derived products.

Viral clearance studies for biologics, gene therapies, and other biopharmaceutical products, including investigational and regulatory-supporting study designs.

Custom cell culture and cell banking support, including cell line expansion, research cell banking, conditioned medium production, virus production, and purification.

Bioassays and analytical support, including in vitro and in vivo bioassays, immune response evaluation, qPCR-based detection, and related testing for preclinical and clinical programs.

Clients come to Texcell for the science. They stay because of the partnership.

Name: DiNAQOR
Description: DiNAQOR is a genetic medicine platform company pioneering early-stage drug development and manufacturing to advance promising gene therapies to the clinic. Our patent-protected, industry leading platform is designed to overcome the challenges and limitations of advanced gene therapy development by using proprietary engineered heart tissue technology (EHT), a novel Loco-Regional Perfusion system (LRP) and a fully integrated manufacturing solution. Our company is headquartered in the Greater Zurich Area, Switzerland, with additional presence in Laguna Hills, California and  Hamburg, Germany.

Name: Canopy Biosciences
Description: Canopy Biosciences, a Bruker company, empowers innovation by providing access to cutting-edge spatial biology and multi-omic tools so biomedical researchers can drive scientific discovery faster. Our proprietary technology ChipCytometryTM is a quantitative multiplex immunofluorescence imaging method for the spatial analysis of complex tissues and mapping of cell populations with single-cell resolution. Supported by Canopy Spatial ServicesTM with our CLIA-certified laboratory, we provide a unique collection of spatial and single-cell technologies that accelerate the understanding of cellular diversity and interaction. Learn more at CanopyBiosciences.com.

Name: BIOTYPE GmbH
Description:
BIOTYPE is an innovative German solution provider for molecular precision diagnostics. We are committed to advancing precision medicine through our products & services for reliable analysis and interpretation of clinical biomarkers.

BIOTYPE offers a strong portfolio in molecular cancer diagnostics for applications in hemato-oncology, liquid biopsy, and molecular profiling of solid tumors. The portfolio includes IVD assays for clinical diagnostics and RUO assays for translational and clinical research. In addition, BIOTYPE offers high-quality and IVD-compliant contract development and manufacturing services. Our proprietary MODAPLEX platform is a benchtop system for automated molecular profiling and multi-biomarker testing. MODAPLEX addresses the growing need to simplify and accelerate precision testing by reliably delivering actionable molecular information required for biomarker-guided care in precision medicine. The MODAPLEX consolidates multi-gene testing into one workflow with same-day results.

BIOTYPE‘s quality management system is certified according to ISO 9001:2015 & ISO 13485:2016.

Name: Green Elephant Biotech
Description:
We're a team of scientists, engineers, and bioprocess specialists on a mission to make adherent cell manufacturing scalable, reproducible, and simple.

Adherent cell culture has always been the hard part of biomanufacturing — labor-intensive, space-hungry, and difficult to standardize at scale under GMP. We're changing that. CellScrew scales adherent cell culture from lab to production in a compact format — replacing 133 T75 flasks or 12 roller bottles with one vessel, up to 33% less handling time, and the same biology at every scale. 

Archimedes One,  our dynamic bioreactor for adherent cells, takes the next step — automating media exchange, harvest, and process monitoring for GMP-ready adherent cell expansion.

We’re based in Gießen and Berlin, with our own production facility and lab. If you work in bioprocessing, cell therapy, or sustainable biotech — follow along, reach out, or come find us at the next conference.

Name: NIRx Medical Technologies
Description:
NIRx Medical Technologies, LLC is a leading provider of comprehensive solutions for functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) research. 
Our non-invasive and user-friendly fNIRS technology enables the measurement of neural activity in the cortex and large-scale cortical networks, providing valuable insights into the neural mechanisms underlying perception and cognition.

We offer a complete range of research solutions, including a versatile multimodal hardware platform, advanced online and offline analysis software, expert technical and scientific support, and comprehensive training programs.

Whether you're investigating neural activity during development, researching disorders and their treatments, or exploring new applications in neuroscience, NIRx has the expertise and solutions to help you achieve your research goals.

We invite you to explore the NIRx Learning Center, your expert fNIRS support and training hub, accessible free of charge here: https://help.nirx.de/

US/Canada: (+1) 321-352-7570

Name: Hamilton Robotics EMEA
Description:
Hamilton Robotics EMEA delivers precision automated liquid handling systems that accelerate scientific discovery and improve laboratory workflows worldwide.

We design, manufacture, and support a comprehensive portfolio of automated liquid handling solutions, from compact benchtop systems to fully integrated high-throughput workstations. Our offerings include modular liquid handling platforms, application-specific Assay Ready Workstations, precision consumables, and custom OEM integration solutions. Whether automating pipetting, sample preparation, or complex multi-step workflows, our systems deliver unmatched accuracy, reliability, and scalability that grow with your lab.

Name: Nanogami
Description: We are pioneering the next-generation biochip for research, diagnostics, and personalized medicine. Our biochip platform offers ultra-high feature density, modularity, and adaptability to integrate and enhance sequencing, transcriptomics, and proteomics applications. To realize this vision, SPRIND - Germany's Federal Agency for Disruptive Innovation funds Nanogami as one of six projects for the next five years.

Name: Ariceum Therapeutics
Description:
Ariceum Therapeutics is a private, clinical stage radiopharmaceutical company focused on the diagnosis and precision treatment of certain neuroendocrine and other aggressive, hard-to-treat cancers. The name Ariceum is an anagram of ‘Marie Curie’ whose discovery of radium and polonium have been huge contributions to finding treatments for cancer.

Ariceum’s lead targeted systemic radiopharmaceutical candidate, SSO110 (“satoreotide”) labelled with Lutetium-177 (177Lu) and Actinium-255 (255Ac) is an antagonist of the somatostatin type 2 (SSTR2) receptor which is overexpressed in aggressive neuroendocrine tumours (NETs) such as small cell lung cancer (SCLC) or Merkel Cell Carcinoma (MCC), all of which have limited treatment options and poor prognosis. Satoreotide is being developed as a ‘theranostic pair’ for the combined diagnosis and targeted radionuclide treatment of these tumours. Ariceum is also developing a radiolabelled PARP-inhibitor (ATT001), currently in Phase 1 clinical development under the trial name CITADEL-123. ATT001 was part of the acquisition of Theragnostics Ltd which was closed in June 2023.

Ariceum Therapeutics, launched in 2021, acquired all rights to satoreotide from Ipsen, which has remained a shareholder of the Company. Ariceum is headquartered in Berlin, with operations in Germany, Switzerland, Australia, the United Kingdom, and the United States.

Ariceum is led by a highly experienced management team and supported by specialist investors including EQT Life Sciences (formerly LSP), HealthCap, Pureos Bioventures, Andera Partners, and Earlybird Venture Capital.

Name: Eisbach Bio GmbH
Description:
Eisbach Bio is an innovative start-up in biotechnology founded in 2019 as a spin-out of the Biomedical Center Munich. We are developing novel drugs that successfully target molecular vulnerabilities arising in cancer genomes.
Eisbach will beat cancer at its own game.

opto biolabs develops smart illumination devices for the research areas of optogenetics and photopharmacology. Our product portfolio ranges from plate illumination devices, flow cytometry illumination devices to custom build prototypes tailored to your needs!

- Working with complex, toxic, or non-natural proteins
- Fed up of testing multiple cell lines and expression systems

Name: AiCuris Anti-infective Cures AG
Description: AiCuris is meeting the needs of the growing population of immunocompromised people who require precise therapies to effectively treat infection. Name: Vibalogics
Description:
Vibalogics (now part of Recipharm) is a full-service CDMO offering process technical transfer, development, GMP manufacturing, testing and fill-finish services to innovators developing virotherapies. Through a comprehensive set of clinical- and commercial-enabling service offerings, we partner with our clients to support early-to-late stage success. Name: QIMA Monasterium GmbH
Description:
Monasterium Laboratory offer Preclinical Services in skin and hair follicle research and development. Our philosophy is to operate as much as possible with intact human hair follicles and skin to better predict the clinical response in vivo. These predictions can then be directly probed in our Clinical Hair Trials Unit.

Monasterium Laboratory also develop custom-designed research assays in skin/hair physiology and pathology for consumer product, pharmaceutical and academic partners. We also run translational research programmes with emphasis on developing innovative pre-clinical research models and identifying novel targets for therapeutic intervention.

Name: CASS Research - Cassava Source Sink Project

 Prof. Dr. Lukas Mueller (Boyce Thompson Institute (BTI), New York, USA)
 Prof. Dr. Lee Sweetlove (University of Oxford, England)

#CassavaResearch #FoodSecurity #ScienceForImpact #GlobalCollaboration #PlantScience #SustainableAgriculture

Name: BIOMEX

BIOMEX is Europe’s leading supplier of human biospecimens for the diagnostics and life sciences industries. With more than 30 years of experience, we can provide you with all kinds of human biosamples, such as blood, disease state plasma, tissue blocks, and much more.

Name: BIO.NRW
Description:
Commissioned by the Ministry of Economic Affairs, Industry, Climate and Energy of North Rhine-Westphalia (MWIKE), BIO.NRW is the state’s central network for strengthening biotechnology with our main focus areas of pharmaceutical biotechnology, industrial biotechnology, and bioeconomy. Since 2009, we have been driving innovation and sustainable economic growth in Germany’s most populous and industrially powerful federal state, with our office managed by Forschungszentrum Jülich.
NRW is home to a thriving ecosystem of life sciences, cutting-edge research, and forward-thinking industries. BIO.NRW acts as a strategic partner, fostering collaboration between businesses, research institutions, and policymakers to enhance value chains in:
- Pharmaceutical Biotechnology – Accelerating drug development and medical advancements.
- Industrial Biotechnology – Enabling sustainable production processes.
- Bioeconomy – Promoting renewable resources and circular economies.

Name: Camm Solutions
Description:
Camm Solutions is a greentech company that has developed the fully sustainable and commercially viable material solution CAMM to combat global (micro)plastic pollution and eliminate waste. 

CAMM represents a breakthrough in material science, copying nature's own processes. It's engineered to function like plastic, yet when it's time to decompose, it does so with care for the environment, integrating back into the ecosystem without leaving harmful traces. When laminated or extruded onto paper, CAMM rivals the properties of multilayer packaging. In the recycling process, the CAMM layer washes away, enabling complete paper fiber recovery – a stark contrast to typical packaging that retains microplastics.

Camm Solutions was initiated by Christoph Bertsch, a serial entrepreneur with over 25 years of experience, who was driven to solve the microplastic problem for one of his other companies. The CAMM idea resulted out of that quest. Supported by a diverse international group of shareholders representing the full CAMM value chain from raw material to recycling, close to €50M were invested to develop patented CAMM formulations and launch sustainable game changers like CAMM airpillows and stretchfilm. Today, CAMM embodies a practical vision of sustainability, proving that innovative ideas can create real-world eco-friendly solutions.

Name: M2-Instruments GmbH
Description:
M2-Instruments GmbH develops and manufactures the iFOUR, a compact benchtop instrument for automated non-contact microdispensing from picoliter to nanoliter volumes.

The iFOUR is designed for research groups, biotechnology companies and diagnostic developers that need to deposit small liquid volumes precisely and reproducibly onto defined substrates. Typical applications include protein, DNA and antibody microarrays, biosensor functionalization, diagnostic assay development, multiplex ELISA, lateral flow applications, lab-on-a-chip, microfluidics and MALDI sample preparation.

Depending on the configuration, the iFOUR can integrate piezo-driven picoliter dispensing or pressure-based nanoliter dispensing. It can process biomolecules, reagents, cells and particle-containing samples and dispense onto microscope slides, microplates, membranes, biosensors, cartridges, microfluidic devices, wafers and other application-specific targets.

Integrated droplet observation, target inspection, environmental control and flexible waveform generation support the development and validation of stable dispensing processes. These functions help users evaluate droplet formation, positioning and reproducibility while reducing the consumption of precious samples.

M2-Instruments is part of the M2 Group. We focus on the development and production of the standardized iFOUR benchtop platform in Wildau, near Berlin. Our affiliated company M2-Automation GmbH provides a wider portfolio of configurable microdispensing systems for research, batch production and customized inline automation.

Founded in 2021, M2-Instruments supports customers worldwide directly and through authorized distribution partners.

Priavoid has built a focused pipeline of detangler compounds that are non-immunogenic and reach their oligomer targets in the brain and inside the affected cells. Description:

By working with scientists of different research fields and pharmaceutical companies, we want to integrate circadian rhythm-based interventions in pharmacological research and drug development to optimize drug efficacy and diminish toxicity in cancer treatment. Our ultimate goal is to make circadian rhythm-based interventions an integral part of healthcare and enable individuals to live healthier, and more enjoyable lives.
Our story: TimeTeller is a spin-off of the Charité Universitätsmedizin Berlin and builds upon the research of the Circadian Medicine and Systems Biology research group lead by Angela Relógio and on her vision to translate her research findings into a product to benefit the patients. TimeTeller as a project was initially funded by „Inventors for Health“ (I4H)-program by the Stiftung Charité and later by the Digital Health Accelerator (DHA) from the Berlin Institute of Health (BIH). Name: Akribion Therapeutics
Description:
Akribion Therapeutics is developing a unique, RNA-guided, nuclease-based technology for programmable cell depletion. Its G-dase E payload has the ability to kill cells by shredding DNA and RNA, but only if there is a highly specific match between the guide RNA and an intracellular RNA sequence, ensuring that only the targeted cells are affected, leaving healthy cells unharmed. 

Initially targeting HPV-induced Oropharyngeal Head & Neck Cancer (OPSCC), Akribion is exploring additional applications in oncology, autoimmune diseases, fibrosis, and infectious diseases. 

The flexibility and broad potential of Akribion's technology makes it a promising platform for various therapeutic areas, as by simply changing the guide RNA, the technology can be quickly adapted to target different cells, making it much faster to develop new treatments compared to traditional methods.

Founded in 2024 and based in Zwingenberg, Germany, Akribion was spun out of BRAIN Biotech AG, the specialist in biosolutions for industrial applications.

Name: Dynamic Matrices
Description:

- LASSO — a programmable, interface-free pulldown system that lets you capture biomolecule & release in solution with near-zero non-specificity .

Name: NEOsphere Biotechnologies GmbH

NEOsphere Biotechnologies integrates world-class mass spectrometry with expert data analysis to systematically build comprehensive pipelines of novel degrader targets. We support our partners' targeted protein degradation (TPD) drug discovery programs across all stages.

Our deep proteomic screening platform, which is target- and E3 ligase-agnostic, enables unbiased, high-throughput screening of entire degrader libraries. With unparalleled proteome coverage, sensitivity, precision, and rapid turnaround, we unlock the previously undruggable target space. Our platform characterizes all degrader types, identifying molecules that engage new E3 ligases and emerging TPD mechanisms. We confirm potential degrader targets and modifications through global ubiquitinomics, achieving unprecedented coverage of > 50,000 ubiquitination sites.

Our proprietary data analysis suite is designed for interactive and user-friendly exploration of large proteomics datasets, enabling informed decision-making, SAR optimization, target identification, and library expansion.

Name: Thermosome
Description:
Thermosome is a clinical-stage drug development company focused on targeted tumor therapy combined with immune stimulation for improved cancer therapy. At its core is a novel, proprietary tumor targeting approach that allows for significantly increased local drug concentrations and improved tumor penetration to achieve improved clinical treatment efficacy. 

Thermosome’s lead drug candidate THE001 is a thermosensitive liposomal formulation of the chemotherapeutic drug doxorubicin (DPPG2-TSL-DOX). It has a different mode of action than conventional liposomes. Thermosome's technology enables intravascular drug release initiated by a mild heat trigger using clinically established hyperthermia devices. This results in an up to 15-fold higher local drug concentrations in the tumor and aims to improve clinical treatment efficacy by creating a local boost at the desired site of action. These high local concentrations, which also reach less well perfused areas, aim to overcome drug resistance. This effect cannot be achieved by administration of conventional doxorubicin due to systemic toxicity. Thermosome intends to further enhance treatment efficacy through an additive immune response induced by regional hyperthermia.

The first clinical indication for its lead drug candidate THE001 is soft tissue sarcoma, where the company aims to improve the current standard of care (free doxorubicin). Thermosome ́s approach enables targeted tumor treatment independent of specific molecular targets and covers patient populations across all tumor subtypes. THE001 has further development potential in other anthracycline-sensitive solid tumors, such as breast cancer, bladder cancer or ovarian carcinoma.

Name: Secalflor Sur
Description:
La idea de SECALFLOR nació en 1994 en Rheinsberg, al norte de Berlín. Desarrollado inicialmente sólo para el control de la erosión (vertederos, antiguas minas, etc.), los primeros ensayos de campo mostraron rápidamente las propiedades únicas del material base para la retención de agua y sus efectos positivos en el crecimiento de las plantas. Los primeros proyectos comenzaron en el área de Rheinsberg, y la aplicación de los paneles se fue extendiendo a otros sectores: agricultura, parques y jardines y tejados y cubiertas verdes; siempre con el objetivo de que nuestro producto fuera de uso universal.

La mezcla patentada y 100% ecológica de fibras de celulosa, almidón vegetal y aditivos minerales, garantiza un aumento del crecimiento de las plantas en todas las condiciones climáticas, incluso en circunstancias de sequía extrema. El uso de agua, nutrientes y pesticidas puede reducirse considerablemente gracias a las propiedades únicas y naturales de los paneles de SECALFLOR, que abren oportunidades para diferentes sectores e industrias.

Desde hace 20 años, los paneles de SECALFLOR han demostrado su eficacia en todo el mundo bajo las más diversas condiciones ambientales. Ante el que quizá sea el mayor reto de nuestro tiempo, el cambio climático con sus extremos meteorológicos y sus periodos de sequía, SECALFLOR asegura la continuidad de paisajes verdes y florecientes y cosechas más abundantes.

SECALFLOR sigue investigando y desarrollando su producto para optimizar los mecanismos de acción y encontrar nuevos ámbitos de aplicación. Para ello, hacemos especial hincapié en aportar los conocimientos técnicos de los últimos 20 años a todos los proyectos que hemos desarrollado en Alemania y en otros países del mundo.

Nuestro objetivo es producir los paneles con materias primas locales tanto en nuestra fábrica de Alemania, como en la nueva fábrica que se abrirá en España a través de nuestra filial ubicada en dicho país.
